After 70 grueling years of military service, he's finally permitted to retire from his position as Grand Commander. Once he regains his youth through rejuvenescence, Yi Gwol secretly passes on several powerful swords to his junior disciples before starting his carefree life as a teahouse owner. But what began as a small gesture is about to cause a big conflict in the martial world...

(Source: Tapas)

Peter starts working at a factory, where he finds more than just a job... 

(Source: Toomics)

A trio of friends had a special agreement. They'd all have fun together but just stay friends. After a hiatus, they meet up again to find that those feelings aren't just simply bottled up... 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

A former actress is determined to do anything to get back to the top, even if means going underground to the world of porn. 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Delano and Jacob were childhood friends... until one day Delano catches Jacob getting intimate with Everett, Delano's brother! The two become enemies, but they somehow ended up as roommates in college. Delano is a popular jock, while Jacob is a nerdy loner with an aggressive potty-mouth. When Jacob catches the eye of Tristan, the campus flirt, Delano finally admits to himself that he's always had feelings for Jacob. Tristan has some dastardly plans for Jacob though... Will Delano save Jacob before it's too late? 

(Source: Tapas)

The heir to a rich family meets his father's concubine for the first time and falls in love with her. He knows it is wrong, but crosses the line, unable to resist her sweet temptation...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Shi-hyuk truly had it all. He was good-looking and could get any woman he wanted. But all that changed when one night, he just couldn’t get it up! What’s going on down there?! Defeated, all Shi-hyuk can do is take his L for now. But then, at home, something strange has begun to happen. A weird sensation has started to come over him, like somebody is aggressively touching his junk…! Visibly aroused, Shi-hyuk can’t let his roommate, Hyunwoo, see him in such a vulnerable state. But wait, could it be? Those trick-or-treaters last Halloween… Was their “trick” a hex?! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

“Can a human trust another human? To trust is to gamble. Then where should I bet?” The notorious mafia “Sambuca” abducts children and produces drugs. To fight against them, Mi-Ho Won, the heir of one of the wealthiest families in Korea, recruits immortal girl Suk-Ui Kang and former mafia member Lilia to form “The QUEENS.” Will The QUEENS be able to win the war against Sambuca? 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

display_title: My Husband, My Sister, and I
description:
*“I taste her on your lips.”*

On the night of our fourth wedding anniversary, I witnessed my husband having an affair. "I love you," he told my twin sister as he laid on top of her. This can't just end easily with a divorce. No, I'll make them pay for this. 

(Source: Manta)

In a suspicious car accident, Seo Jiwoon's sister dies while top actor Cha Taehyuk walks off unscathed. While trying to uncover the truth, Jiwoon is also hit by a car. However, when he opens his eyes, Jiwoon realizes he has traveled back in time to his first day of work. Will this opportunity to work together with Cha Taehyuk be the perfect opportunity to avenge his sister's death? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Junbeom runs into Jina, an exorcist who captures mystical monsters called “Shingis.” She gives Jumbeom a bell to protect him, which unexpectedly turns Junbeom into a shingi! Desperate to return to his regular human self, the two look for the man that sold Jina the bell, but he has disappeared. They follow a lead and locate the billionaire who owned the bell before a burglar stole it from him. However, Junbeom and Jina must first catch the burglar before he’s willing to help. Will they ever succeed in returning Junbeom to his former self? 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Mov Saga Online is an MMORPG based in virtual reality. Zerry has been a player since the game’s early days, yet he’s still stuck as a low-level novice. That’s because the idea of running through dungeons and completing quests has never interested him. He’d much rather stay cooped up in his virtual home, eating snacks all day. However, his gaming life takes a one-eighty when he suddenly stumbles upon a rare weapon that grants him exclusive access to an epic quest! With the encouragement and anticipation of his friend, Tana, Zerry finally begins leveling himself up to take on the challenge. But this epic quest will soon turn out to be much more than both players bargained for…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Jeon Du-In’s relationship with Baek Ryong is complicated. He gets paid by Ryong to do dirty jobs, which is standard fare for a thug like him. The fact that they have sex together doesn’t make things that messy, either. The part where everything gets complicated is the fact that Du-In doesn’t really want any kind of relationship with Ryong in the first place. Du-In isn’t the type of man to be domesticated, and Ryong likes him that way…But he doesn’t want to let his “beast” go, either. A savagely captivating prequel to “Dispar”.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

Prophet Liye falls into a world where magic exists and wakes up as a woman that a shaman doctor resurrected when she was a little girl. Tanaril, a wizard cursed by a witch to never have children with any woman, meets Liye at a hotel bar by chance. After drinking cocktails from a bartender at the bar, they spend the night together. Tanaril misunderstands that Liye approached him on purpose and accuses her of approaching him to take advantage of his high status. Despite how she was offended by his accusations, she became pregnant with his child. After announcing the pregnancy through a magical letter, the two get married by contract for different reasons and purposes. She knows she shouldn't fall in love with Tanaril, since she's from a different world and all that. It'll be a piece of cake since Tanaril is a cold, distant person, right? But her expectations are ruined when she discovers that Tanaril is actually caring and warm. 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

My jealousy for you has now turned into love. Will you forgive me for ruining your life?

(Source: Lalatoon)

Mystic World--a virtual reality RPG game. Beopgyu Lee, the developer of Mystic World, wakes up to find himself in a strange lab which he recognizes as one of the settings from his game. To make matters worse, he is in the body of Han Lee, a notorious villain character. Find out how Beopgyu survives as Han in the game he created--not as the main character but as the master of villains! 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

When the emperor murders the python, god of the waters, a curse is put over the Cha Kingdom preventing men from succeeding the throne. So begins the reign of empresses and the endless struggle against men who try to control the kingdom. After all her sisters are killed by the hands of Yom, the young Empress is seated on the throne. Rather than performing her duties as a ruler of a kingdom, the empress spends her days and nights drinking and sleeping with different men, whom she all executes immediately after. The people call her the Blood Empress, attributed to her violent behavior and the red hair, which is dyed with the blood of the men she killed. One day, the Empress meets a handsome and intellectual young man named Kanghee. As she picks up her sword to kill him, Kanghee convinces her to spare him and begins to captivate her heart by telling her stories he's read from book. As the empress gets closer and closer to Kanghee, she begins to change her violent ways. Is he someone she can finally put her trust in? Or is he not?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

A dream romance between the sIn a society where people are in tune with their genetics, Hajin Kim was born as a recessive Omega, but he’s is in love with a dominant Alpha named Soohyuk Cha. For seven years, Hajin watches Soohyuk from a distance until one day, he overhears that Soohyuk will soon be leaving to study abroad. As a farewell, Hajin vows to sleep with Soohyuk. Despite learning certain dark details about Soohyuk’s character, Hajin makes a choice in a moment of desperation and madness. And now Soohyuk is on the prowl, looking for him. Is this Alpha trying to destroy Hajin, or... has something else taken root? Something like love?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Due to an unexpected accident, Choi Yu-Jeong, an ordinary college student, owes some money from the owner of a cafe called "Delicious Blood." Daniel, the owner of the cafe, tells Choi Yu-Jeong to pay off her debts by working part-time at his cafe. Choi Yu-Jeong eventually starts a part-time job, but the handsome boss Daniel, doesn't let her off the hook.

Who is Daniel? And what will happen to Yu-Jeong?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

The mighty Leon has long ruled over Dark Fall. But when he mysteriously loses his powers, his obedient followers turn into dangerous enemies. And it isn’t simple revenge that they’re after. Instead, they want him to bear a new king of Dark Fall in his womb, while becoming their plaything in the process. Soon, Leon’s budding libido is stimulated for this very purpose, and Dark Fall’s once-great ruler is brought to his knees. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Editor's Comment: This comic contains violent sexual content that some readers may find uncomfortable.*

Eric doesn't want to revisit anything about what happened before he left. But going to school and meeting Avery is making that very difficult. Will he be able to climb out of the swamp?

(Source: Toomics)

A businesswoman who is in her thirties, Yu-Gyeong Seo. She’s in a relationship that seems to be sinking every second. One day, her younger brother’s friend, I-Jun Gwon, abruptly comes into her life physically and mentally, starting an odd cohabitation. I-Jun Gwon, although he is the perfect house husband material, good at all kinds of house chores, he seems to dislike treating Yu-Gyeong as a senior. Why does he care for her so much? Why does he not like to treat her as Nuna? Well, maybe this cohabitation is rather impure. 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

My name is Han San, and my life is pretty simple... or at least it was until Lee Garam came along and flipped everything upside-down. He said he traveled from one month in the future to save my life and insisted on living together to ensure my safety. I don't know if it's because I felt this odd connection to him, but like a crazy person, I agreed. I still don't know what to believe, but with the recent arson attacks in our neighborhood, Garam's story is starting to seem less far-fetched...

(Source: Tapas)

I'm busy writing my e-book, taking classes, and having a crush on the hottest chick on campus. But why do I keep thinking of my friend?

(Source: Tooomics)

Meet Ji Yoonyoung, a BL novelist who has everything—except the ability to write spicy scenes! With deadlines constantly looming and his editor, Lee Sero, sending back relentless critiques, Yoonyoung is in a creative crisis. After another long night of frustration, Yoonyoung decides to drink his sorrows away and ends up spilling his biggest secret to Sero: he's never actually experienced what he's trying to write! 

Sero’s unexpected response? "If experience is the problem, let’s fix that."" 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Angel is on the run from his brother and Ian Summers when he resorts to hiding out at his childhood friend Herman Black's house. During their time living together, Herman turns out to be devoted to Angel while Angel blames Herman for the way things turned out. They may be lovers now, but their history goes way back. Will their reunion turn out to be a curse or a blessing? 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Several days of torture is not enough to make the Captain disclose the location of his team’s safe house. Seeing that their tricks are working in vain, his captors call in the Colonel to get the vital information out of him. This cold-blooded Colonel will readily kill anyone within a heartbeat to get the information he needs. However, the Captain just so happens to have a pretty face…and the Colonel knows just what he wants to do to it. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

For as long as I can remember, I've been fascinated by violence. But the fixation turned out to be a disguised longing for pain, and in turn, my deepest, darkest secret. I can't let anyone find out, but I also can't help but wonder - will I ever find someone to quench my desires? Or will my fantasy remain unfulfilled... forever? What lies in the end of a pain-fueled revenge?! 

*Editor's Comment: This comic contains graphic depictions of rape and violence. Reader discretion is advised.* 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jang Jae-Woong is a golden boy. Kind-hearted and sharp-eyed but somewhat ditzy, he falls in love at first sight with Sim Jae-Yul, a man he meets on campus. Everything is all well and good until Jae-Woong starts centering his life around Sim in an attempt to catch his eye…and a momentary mistake lands the two not only in a life-threatening situation, but a whirlwind relationship!

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count includes three side story chapters.*

This is a story about Kanghyun and Dojun's twisted love story. With a bizarre serial killer on the loose, two different yet similar high school boys have a brief fateful encounter. Without the chance to express their feelings, they were separated due to Dojun's father's death and 10 years pass by. The return of the bizarre serial killer reunite Kanghyun and Dojun for their fate to begin again.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and epilogue.*

Eun-Jae only agreed to date Tae-Sung to take advantage of him, but can he handle Tae-Sung's growing desires?

(Source: Lalatoon)

Chun-Sik Kim is the CEO of Novis Company, the company behind the VR RPG Novis World, but he has never played his own game before. After claiming that he could become a top ranker without paying any money at an update preview event, he starts Novis World with only his secretary and passion by his side. Will this old dog be able to learn new tricks and become the top ranker in Novis World? 

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

What are the odds of running into a one-night stand on the street?
Jitae can't muster the courage to tell his straight friend Kyunghoon that he's had a crush on him for a long time. Much to his dismay, Kyunghoon announces his engagement to his pregnant fiancée.
Shattered, Jitae has a one-night stand with a random guy he meets at a gay bar. As if congratulating a years-long crush on his wedding day isn't hard enough, Jitae runs into the one-night stand who happens to be the bride's brother! But Haejoon doesn't seem to want to remain a casual sex partner to Jitae. He comes on to Jitae with a hint of threat and an offer hard to refuse.
"Don't do it. Choose me, instead. I'll make you get over him." 

(Source: NETCOMICS)

'Delivering pleasure directly to the clients!' GUN-WOO starts working at a mysterious delivery company, and soon finds that he has real talent in satisfying his clients. "Ma'am! You can't do that!" 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

display_title: Lessons in Seduction with a Classy Duke
description:
Lillian didn't marry Arthur for love, but loveless unions are ubiquitous in high society. However, when Lillian is confronted with incriminating evidence that reveals her husband's twisted desires, she's forced to decide whether she really wants to leave. Little does Arthur know that his wife is more than willing to indulge his sick fantasies. And now, he's ready to make Lillian his, as long as she's prepared to submit. As the pair becomes entangled in a dangerous love affair that blurs the lines between passion and obsession, they must fend off intrusive reporters, feisty former flames, and incredibly nosy neighbors all determined to tear them apart. Just how far is Lillian willing to go to satisfy Arthur's depravity? Does she have what it takes to be the wife of the esteemed Duke Arthur Astrid? 

(Source: Tappytoon) 

*Notes: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

Lucy Leopardi has no friends. But of course she doesn’t—she’s a lamb born into a family of lions! Lonely, insecure, and desperate for friendship, Lucy can’t wait to make her first friend. One fateful night on a ballroom balcony, she meets Roman, a charming, young dog with whom she makes an instant connection. But when his association with the infamous House of Baskerville comes to light, will their newfound friendship blossom, or will dishonesty bite into their budding relationship?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Chapter count includes 20 side story chapters.*

Jinha is an Omega with an Alpha phobia and Tae-Oh is his boyfriend who hasn't awakened yet. Tae-Oh has tried many methods to awaken his Alpha traits, but something inside him is preventing it. While Jinha tries to be strong for Tae-Oh, shady figures lurk to take advantage of his phobia. 

(Source: INKR)

Da-Young Kim happily donated her liver to her mother-in-law, but all she got was betrayal in return. Her husband’s whole family nefariously used and abused her, kicking her out before she even fully recovered from surgery. They went on with their lives, blissfully unaware that Da-Young swore revenge. She begins to systematically destroy their lives as they did hers, but what happens when someone unexpected gets in the way of her best-laid plans? Will accomplishing her mission bring her happiness… or will it only get in the way of true love? 

(Source: Tapas)

Jay is an 8th rank public official. She works as a special guardian, and her mission is to heal children whose souls have been deeply wounded. Ludwig shuts himself off from the world. He seems as if he's forgotten how to smile. However, he learns what it means to be happy through Jay, and Jay cherishes him as her own precious Hunny bunny.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

display_title: Her Ladyship Objects to this Marriage!
description:
Lady Kyriel, the strong-willed commandant of the Alteion Empire, does not want to get married. However, when she finds herself in an arranged union, she is surprised to find that it is with a cordial but mysterious sorcerer named Idwin. He somehow checks all her boxes—the boxes she made sure were impossible to check. Kyriel’s unbreakable vow and Idwin’s inescapable fate take them on a journey to their higher purpose—one that involves the past and future of empires and churches.. 

(Source: Tapas)

Expensive shoes, a nice watch. Smoldering good-looks. That’s the new guy, Doh Jaeha, appointed to lead a new team in the company. Tae-eun is a third-year copywriter who’s vying to join this new group to move his career forward. Jaeha seems a bit strict but if he’s achieved this position already at his age, he must be competent, right? But something suddenly dawns on Tae-eun… This Jaeha...is this the same Jaeha he went to school with, his first crush?! Second chances at love don’t come around very often. But they were just kids when they first met, surely things are different now. Still, this guy is confident, hot and seems interested, why not make the most of this opportunity? But office romances are always complicated and there’s a new air about Jaeha that feels just a little off… Love and lust ensue but things aren't quite as they seem... 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes ten extra chapters.*

Jung-Woo goes to this particular study room for one reason: Because of the hot lady who runs it! But his harem is just beginning… 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

"Did he die because of me?" 

Animal behaviorist Hyunwoo's love for penguins drives him all the way over to Antarctica. Once there, however, he encounters a series of mishaps and soon discovers that surviving in the harsh cold is no easy feat. Will Hyunwoo be able to conduct his research and return to Korea in one piece?

(Source: Manta)

Dani Kang sometimes wonders what her life would have been like if she had run away on her wedding day. She was a successful career woman before getting married, but now she is divorced, unemployed, and a single mother of one. During her divorce, her life got turned upside down as she found herself not only struggling to re-enter the professional world after having taken a long break from it but in desperate need of a home as well. When her dear friend, Eunho Cha, who is a successful author and a chief editor at a publishing company, asks Dani to help him find a housekeeper, she decides to take up that job herself without his knowledge. Eventually, she gets discovered and receives help from Eunho, but then their lives become even more intertwined when Dani applies for an open position at his company. Will they be able to navigate through all the personal and professional challenges lying ahead of them? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

A world where age is just a number.
College student Soong has a secret: she’s 121 years old. With the invention of a wonder drug, anyone can look 21 again. And in a world without visible aging, why act your age? Anything is possible — even a romance with a man 100 years your junior.

(Source: Manta)

I'm a country boy moving to the city for a new job and the building's full of hot girls. I think I'm gonna enjoy my stay.

(Source: Toomics)

Cha Jae-Hyeon’s had it easy for the past few years. His job as a PE teacher is a no-brainer, plus, he’s enjoying the more illicit perks that come with the job. However, his comfy lifestyle is brought into peril with the appearance of the deceptively soft-spoken school inspector, Lee Sun-Jin. Sun-Jin catches onto Jaehyun’s secret and uses it to get what he wants, which is…to do whatever he desires to Jae-Hyeon's body. Initially, Jae-Hyeon only feels humiliation, but humiliation quickly turns into something different. It’s a physical education like no other, one where excrutiating pain turns into inexorable pleasure. A new series from the writer of “Dine With a Vampire!"

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: My Sweetheart Duke Has a Secret
description:
Noel—the adopted anthropomorphic daughter of the Miceria family—is abused and neglected by everyone after her mother passes away from an accident. Alone and grief-stricken, her only source of comfort is her secret wizard friend Sion. 

But when Noel accidentally hears about her step-father's horrific plan, she begs Sion to help her escape the Miceria household. Turns out that Sion is a magical duke who can easily get rid of people in the blink of an eye! Sion then offers Noel to work for him as his assistant. Is this an offer of a lifetime, or a trap? What is Sion planning to do with Noel? 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

As a lonely orphan and a corporate heir, the lives of Seo Yeon-Woo and Lee Seok-Heon couldn’t be any more different. Due to this, Yeon-Woo has been unable to refuse Seok-Heon’s advances to be his sex partner. But as Seok-Heon’s grandfather was the one to take Yeon-Woo in when she was orphaned, the guilt of sleeping with her savior’s grandson weighs heavily on her mind. She finally draws the line when Seok-Heon pulls out a wedding ring, professing that he’s willing to go against his family’s wishes and marry Yeon-Woo. No longer wanting to become a burden to those around her, Yeon-Woo decides to pack her bags and run far away. But just when everything seems okay, Yeon-Woo learns that she has an unexpected baby on the way… 

(Source: Tappytoon, edited) 

*Note: Includes a prologue.*

Eun-Ha Cheon was just an ordinary teenage girl until she woke up one day and discovered that she was not Eun-Ha Cheon anymore, but a witch named Blythe in a magical world. Fearful of prejudice and desirous of a quiet life, she hides the fact that she’s a witch, but this becomes tricky with the arrival of a beautiful fairy who won’t stop calling her a warrior. She doesn’t want to be a warrior or anyone’s hero. All she wants is an ordinary life… But as she learns more about her identity and her world, will she ultimately get what she wants?

(Source: Tapas)

Yejun has worked tirelessly to put his troubled past behind him and is now a respected history teacher. However, when his estranged high school friend, Minhyuk, unexpectedly shows up as his teaching assistant, Yejun’s carefully constructed new life is threatened. Minhyuk is a painful reminder of Yejun’s past ever since their relationship ended on a bitter note. Despite any attempts to keep their interaction strictly professional, Minhyuk persists in acting as if they are still close friends. Yejun knows that moving on from past wounds isn’t as easy as retaking a test, but could they redefine their relationship from colleagues to lovers? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Heesuh hates Jinmoo, always has and always will. However, his plan to destroy Jinmoo’s life flops because instead of humiliating Jinmoo, the pair spends a passionate night together. Jinmoo wants to take responsibility for his drunk actions, and Heesuh is definitely only dating him for another shot at revenge because there is no way Heesuh is falling for his sexy, sexy enemy. 

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note: Chapter count includes 12 side stories*

*"I'll keep your secret. Do it with me instead."* 

Byung-tae has loved Eun-ah purely since he was young. One day, he finds out her secret and decides to stick to his instincts. 

(Source: LezhinX)

Welcome to Ubrade, your majesty.

After falling into an icy pond, Min-Hu wakes up in an unfamiliar world. He soon realizes he's the prophesied hero who's supposed to bring salvation to Ubrade by marrying Emperor Sioen. Will Min-Hu find his way back to earth? Or will he accept his destiny as the savior?

(Source: Manta)

Do you have what it takes to be a plant nerd? As celebrated comic artist Milo strives to level up her gardening game, defeat aggressive and invasive pests, propagate fickle flora, and balance her adult plants’ rising demands, she has one goal in mind: to keep her plants alive! Gardening seems like a peaceful hobby from afar, but for this dedicated green thumb, every day is war! 

(Source: Tapas)

Everything about Jungwoo is average…apart from his abnormal fetish for female pro golfers. Jungwoo knows that he can’t let his fetish get the better of him, so he decides to quench his obsession by working at a swanky golf club. However, the first girl he bumps into on the field is none other than all-time star golfer, Park Sojung, who also happens to be the reason he got this fetish in the first place! Between settling in his new job and keeping it in his pants around hot female golfers who seem to crave his touch, will Jungwoo be able to overcome his fetish and achieve his hole in one?

(Source: Lezhin X)

*"Don't you remember me? I'm the wimp you used to bully back in college."*

10 years ago, this man lost everything to the campus bullies. It's time to take his sweet revenge.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Rahyeon, a passive student who usually has bad luck, manages to attend a prestigious college. But was it karma? On the first day of admission he gets involved with a very beautiful but crazy person...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

During a chance meeting, Princess Asché shares an unforgettable kiss with Ethan, the second prince of a nearby empire. Years later, Asché’s brother arranges a marriage that will force her to become the Emperor’s ninth wife. Rather than suffer in a loveless union, Asché poisons her brother, and is imprisoned in the palace for her crime. But as revolution stirs, Ethan, now an anti-imperial rebel, suddenly reappears in her bedroom, and a steamy romance fraught with political implications begins. 

(Source: Tapas)

Ah-choo! Something about being around Jaehyun just gives Suyong the urge to sneeze. On the one hand, Suyong’s body seems to be rejecting Jaehyun’s mere presence but on the other…they can’t seem to keep their hands off of each other. Seems like these two are the definition of love-hate relationship. The plot is always the same in these stories. They end up getting into the same college, becoming roommates and then living happily ever after. Right? Well, not quite for our dynamic frenemy duo. Suyong’s sneezing fits end up ruining everything. He and good buddy Kim Norman have to matriculate a year later than planned. But a chance run-in on campus lands Suyong and Jaehyun back at each other’s throats. Or is it with their tongues down each other’s throats? Oh, and just who’s the top and who’s the bottom here? Something’s gotta give...and where does our little friend Normie fit into this topsy-turvy mess? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

**“I've just recently found out that I can neither be seen nor heard. Now what??”** 

Four people try running away from their problems, all for different reasons. Then, they suddenly become invisible?! They’ll have to face the reality from which they ran in order to become visible once more. 

(Source: Comikey)

display_title: The Tale of the Frost Flower
description:
An imperial scandal and a shattered first love. Sabi is secretly in love with her childhood friend Yusu and wishes to marry him. But the day after her coming-of-age celebration, she finds herself embroiled in a scandalous rumor and suddenly engaged to the emperor's son. Will Sabi be able to clear her name and find her way back to her true love? 

(Source: Manta)

One day, a near-death experience causes Loelline Deaz to remember her past life, awakening the power to see the future through her dreams. However, there is one vision in particular that weighs on her the most-- she foresees the murder of the empire’s hero, Duke Dante Van Benerit! Loelline is the only one who can save the duke, but as she gets closer to uncovering the conspiracy behind his demise, she realizes that her past may have more to do with the grim future than she could’ve ever dreamed…

(Source: Tapas)

Unforeseen guests and unforeseen temptations are in the air!

(Source: Toomics)

Please let this be a bad dream! Our protagonist wakes up to find herself in the world of a novel she wrote in middle school—one she's tried to burn to ashes! Follow Rayna Solei as she navigates her new reality with her loyal servants and a trusty black dragon! Will she ever find her way out of the novel and back to real life?

(Source: Manta)

On the Day of Judgment, monsters from other dimensions invaded earth. Thirty-two years later, humans with special abilities called hunters fight the monsters to keep humanity safe. They train in an online game called “Lost City”—but the best player, Jinsoo Kwon a.k.a. “Unknown,” is no hunter. He only plays the game to earn money for his sister’s medical bills. But when a guild recruits Jinsoo to be a hunter in return for medicine, it’s an offer he can’t refuse. It’s time for this fighting legend to protect his home and his family!

(Source: Tapas)

At his uncle’s funeral, Jeonghan is reunited with Iljo, a man he hasn’t seen in years. It turns out Iljo’s struggling to stay afloat. Stirred by pity and charitable impulse, Jeonghan invites Iljo to move in with him. The problem is that Iljo catches feelings like a match to fuel. To top it off, Jeonghan isn’t keen on dating him, but somehow, he’s a pro at accidentally making things a lot messier for everyone involved. Is this a love story in the making, or a disaster waiting to happen? 

(Source: Tapas)

When he was young, he followed his father to the palace, but happened to meet Crown Prince Gi-Ryeon. Sin-Yeon falls in love at first sight when he sees a manly and beautiful prince, and Gi-Ryeon also likes Sin-Yeon's innocent and pretty appearance. As time goes by Sin-Yeon realizes what he feels like every time he meets Gi-Ryeon, he eventually leaves for a dangerous outskirts to control his growing heart.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

A happy marriage came crashing down when he found out his wife was cheating on him with his best friend. 

*"I'll make all those bitches beg before me!"* 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Scarlet Mathia, the eldest daughter of a poor Baron family, heads to the capital to earn money by playing the piano. After three years, instead of using her piano skills, she decides to marry Edward... but he was already engaged! Eventually, she is betrayed by the man she trusted...

Then one day, a notorious marquess asks her to participate in taking revenge on Edward...

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

A revered war hero, Commander Li Xiao leaves the battlefield to become the Director of the Government General. On his first day of the job, he meets Hwa-Su, a high class male escort, in action. Hwa-Su seems to recognize Li Xiao from before but Li Xiao simply thinks of Hwa-Su as a disgrace to mankind for being a male escort spreading his legs for the same sex. However, by a twist of fate, Li Xiao finds himself being drawn to him...

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

What if one day you found out to be sharing a soul with another person from a different time? And what if that person is no other than a historical figure ruling over the kingdom?

Sian was living a tragic life. Her parents had passed away, and her uncle and aunt, who took her, treated her basely without showing any affection. Her day-to-day misery finally takes an upturn when she gets sucked into a fantastical world she only read about in her books. When she opens her eyes, she is holding an Excalibur in front of the people who are too dazed to speak. When they come to their senses, people start to call her Queen Arthur. Everything is a blur, and Sian can't make out what's happening until she learns she is sharing a soul with King Arthur Pendragon.

Sian's adventure of becoming a queen begins, and it appears smooth sailing until she learns that she bears a mission, and that is to get a hold of the Holy Grail and correct the mistakes of King Arthur, ensuring that the people in the Kingdom of Britain will live happily ever after. Surrounded by her knights, the great wizard, and enemies, she sets out on the journey of becoming a wise and loving queen who wants to bring peace and happiness to this land.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

How far would you go for fame and wealth? Fledgling mommy influencer Ju-Yeon Park is desperate to join the ranks of popular internet celebrities. Thanks to a video of her daughter going viral and her “friend” from high school, popular influencer Ye-Hui Kim, she finally gets the chance to join the ultra-exclusive Deep Pink Society, a group made up of former idols, wealthy CEOs, and social media stars. Elated at the chance to become one of the glittering elite, she’s determined to do whatever it takes to make this work -- no matter the cost.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

display_title: This Life, the Way I Want
description:
When Erina gets adopted by Marquess Sinor because of her magic abilities, she didn't realize her life was only about to get much worse. After years of abuse and torment from the Marquess, Erina is on the verge of breaking down. Just when she decides to end it all, Erina is visited by her past self: Marystella, the powerful witch who once ruled the entire kingdom. Marystella asks Erina if she could help her reveal the truth behind her death. In return, she promises Erina to make her the greatest sorcerer that the world has ever seen. No more suffering, no more pain; Erina is about to do whatever she pleases with her newfound power!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

In the near future, everything we experience in our everyday lives can be marketed as content for the masses. On the top video-sharing platform, Vvolume, content creators compete for views, likes, and subscribers in a fierce struggle for fame and wealth. The glitz and glamour of the “Vvolumer” lifestyle takes its toll, however, leading top livestreamer Songyi Baek to make an attempt on her own life -- only to meet Seungho Nam, a kind and hardworking young man with a voice like honey. Brought together by fate, Songyi and Seungho must navigate their way through this digital society, where every aspect of their lives is on display for the world to see 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Siwoo is a member of the idol group Space Age but is aspiring to become an actor. His acting career gets off to a rocky start but when he gets an offer from a powerful (and handsome) executive to keep his career going, this is a deal he can’t refuse... 

(Source: Lezhin US)

U-Yeon has come to in a very compromising position in front of the people he loves. How is this possible? What’s going on? And why is his brother, U-Jin, whom he detests, here? This isn’t right, it has to stop. But who’s in control here? Is this all a dream? This is no ordinary family dinner… 

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Aspiring novelist Kim Woojin has been a side character all his life. He can't write stories that are his own, and he's not even his boyfriend, Minho's, priority. But like every cloud has its silver lining, Woojin’s comes in the form of an aspiring stage actor, Taehwan. However, Taehwan is not without his own problems: he suffers from terrible stage fright that keeps him from taking lead roles. 

A friendship blossoms between Woojin and Taehwan, with each helping the other overcome their fears. Will this newfound friendship remain just that or could Taehwan be the spark that gets Woojin’s creative juices flowing again? And could they both muster up the courage to become the protagonists of their own stories? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Baek Shiwon is swole but always getting himself injured. Oh well, at least this physical therapist is hella cute… But wait, this person is a man! Still, something about him is so attractive, let’s just see where this goes… Things are looking promising until a certain someone that Shiwon is all too familiar with enters the picture…but Shiwon won’t back down without a fight. In the end, who will end up as perfect body partners?

(Source: Lezhin)

Mushy Baldwin is a man whose body melts when the temperature rises around him—or simply when he feels nervous. Due to his special condition, he struggles to find his place in society, let alone hold a job. One day, he receives a visit and invitation from a strange company called "El Dorado," filled with others who seem just as strange as him... if not stranger! 

(Source: Comico) 

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

The world is full of oddities that people just don’t notice. William Valentine probably wouldn’t take note of them either... if he wasn’t assistant to the insensible Eric Hartman, a professional record-keeper of the bizarre. Join these two 9-to-5 gentlemen on their unlikely adventures in search of strange things.

(Source: Tapas)

Yuna never wanted to adopt a dog. But with her partner in mourning–and in desperate need of a boost in morale–she gives in to his humble request. And in the grand tradition of reluctant pet owners, she and their puppy soon become inseparable. The young couple even goes so far as to relocate from Seoul to soothe their new canine pal’s anxiety. After all, there’s nothing like a move to the country to set yourself right. Right?

The idyll of a quiet life soon gives way to a surprising degree of antagonism, including clashes with long-time local residents of a different generation. The culture shock is palpable for all three urban transplants as the isolation of their new environs starts to sink in. They eventually adopt another dog, and still another–all while reckoning with the ups and downs of middle-age and childlessness in an unforgivingly traditional milieu.

(Source: Drawn & Quarterly)

Despite possessing beauty that could guarantee her an easy life, Elizabeth was forced to forge her own path from a young age, living alone in the Forbidden Forest and selling strawberries to get by. But everything changes one day when a handsome duke appears before her. Although he is taken with Elizabeth, she isn’t exactly seen as marriage material by those in the Duke’s circle. Persistent, he invites her to work at his uncle’s mansion as a maid. It’s purely professional, what could go wrong! 

(Source: Tapas)

People have red threads that tie them to their destined significant other. Are Ryeong and Taeseong going to be tangled up by their red threads? Are they just enemies that couldn’t stop bickering? Or are they going to be lovers bound by the red threads? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Hae-Mi is an ordinary high school art teacher. Sure, she gets scolded by the principal a lot, but her personality makes it impossible for anyone to hate her. While Hae-Mi has her eyes set on one of her fellow teachers, things start to get a little more complicated when her old childhood friend steps into the picture. Between the confusion and the drama, the three of them keep crossing paths in unexpected ways. 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

*Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.*

“Life Cry” is the most popular game in the world—an immersive fantasy realm filled with monsters, mages, and mercenaries. For the average gamer, it is the perfect escape from reality. But for Lime, this game is a bit closer to reality than fantasy, not only because he’s a dark gamer exploiting the game’s mechanics to pay his bills, but also because of the uncanny life-like emotions and reactions of the NPCs he meets. As Lime digs deeper into the game, he realizes there may be more to “Life Cry" than meets the eye. 

(Source: Tapas)

Prince Myung Yiyoon of Hwan, burdened by a perilous royal lineage and a secret healing ability, encounters Emperor Ki Woohee in the palace gardens. Despite Woohee's apparent interest and courtship, Yiyoon must navigate the dangers of trusting a powerful figure with an ulterior motive. Will Yiyoon be able to discover the emperor’s true intentions, resisting the seductive trap he has set just for him?

**Original Novel:**  
[RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/1962134397), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/novel/mh1539), [Bookcube](https://www.bookcube.com/detail.asp?series_num=918000469)

**Original Webtoon:**  
[MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000048471), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10637136), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/58083081)

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://www.lezhinus.com/en/comic/sweetest_snare), [Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/107775)

Lee Junghyuk, an incubus, relies on vitality obtained through intimate encounters in people's dreams to survive. However, past trauma has left him emotionally numb, suffering from sexual anhedonia until he meets Yoo Seohee. Their chance encounter at a club leads to an unexpectedly fulfilling night together. Yet, as Junghyuk discovers Seohee's reputation as a notorious playboy at their university, he questions whether their connection can evolve beyond mere partners...

(Source: Lezhin)

Sangil’s high school sweetheart and first love is eager to follow in the footsteps of his father, a professor at a prestigious university. So much so that he gives in to his family and marries, leaving Sangil heartbroken and scarred for years to come. Today, Sangil himself is a professor of Korean Literature who has recently become entangled with a pushy student named Haneul. Sangil finds the relationship entertaining enough at first, but begins developing feelings for Haneul as time goes by. It’s at this moment that Sangil’s first love re-enters his life asking for a second chance.

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: Flowers May Wither but You Remain
description:
At the ancestral estate of Glown Hall, plain and serious Helen Godwin is hired by the wealthy and powerful Somerset family to tutor the young master Henry. Among its dark and ancient halls, Helen hears whispers about a ghost, madness, and something more sinister the Somersets are hiding. It’s not long before she catches the eye of the womanizing Raymond, Henry’s older brother. Even though Helen isn’t the type Raymond usually goes for, something about her is too alluring for him to ignore…

(Source: Tapas)

Duk-Bong was desperate to find excitement in his lonely life, chasing rushes of joy until it lead him to steal a company flash drive from his own friend as a prank. Little did Duk-Bong know that this flash drive held the vilest secret of Korea’s richest tycoon. That one little flash drive nearly got Duk-Bong killed...and now that same flash drive is in the hands of a sadistic young streamer. But Duk-Bong doesn’t care! He’s still alive, and there’s much happiness to be found.

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Swolemates: Toying with the Buff Newbie
description:
Lee Hyeon-Seo had only just started working at a small company that sells sex toys when he was faced with a crisis. The sex toy tester suddenly quit and there was no one to fill his position. Hyeon-Seo was asked to take over the job, but there’s one big problem- Hyeon-Seo’s still a virgin! Luckily, Hyeon-Seo happens to know Jang Seong-Ho, a rising star in the gay porn industry, who is willing to show him the ropes.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

This world is all about the looks, and the winner takes it all. He's always been rejected by the women, but now he is out for revenge with his new appearance. 

*"No woman can resist me now!"* 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Uigang Bang is an ordinary small business owner who leads an ordinary life… until unordinary things start to unfold in his life. His business partner suddenly disappears, leaving a notorious loan shark chasing after his company. His wife and their child-like dog survive an attempted murder by an impulsive killer only to live in fear of his second attack. Uigang faces the killer to end the matter, but things go south and now he faces two dead bodies instead. Just when he’s debating whether to turn himself in, he receives a life-changing offer -- do you want to become a hitman? 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

*Note: Chapter count includes Episode 0.*

Catherine was born as one of the twins, who are believed to bring destruction to the empire. Unlike her sister Lithia, who is treated coldly and grows to despise her, bright and smart Catherine is faced with high expectations from her father. Selected as a candidate to become the Crown Prince’s consort and the future empress, Catherine falls in love with the second prince Allen during her visit to the palace. The precious moments they get to share together end abruptly when Catherine gets caught in the fire set by her sister, causing her to lose everything to Lithia...

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

There’s nothing new about a passed-out guy at a bar. But when a judo champ and student walks home a cutie who’s had a few too many drinks, the athlete falls in love. After a hot night and a weird morning together, he discovers that the one-night stand is actually his music humanities professor—the neighbor who can’t keep his sex noises down at night. And the professor’s double shame of losing his musical ability and having a love affair with his student humiliates him even more, but the prof can’t keep his hands off the hot jock. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seonho is not a wealthy person, but he is an ordinary courier who lives happily ever after. While delivering deliveries as usual, he happens to meet Jun-goo, who bullied him in high school 10 years ago at the delivery place. 

Sun-ho was relieved to see Jun-gu, who did not recognize him, but found traces of the murder in his house, and found out that he was a witness. Seon-ho, caught by Jun-goo, runs errands for Jun-goo again as he did 10 years ago... 

(Source: Naver, translated)

When Suh volunteered as a beta tester for a cutting-edge ultra VR game, he never imagined he'd be stuck there for the next 20 years. It was only after he finally died in the game he managed to "log off" from the game… only to realize five years have passed in real-life. Reality seemed a lot harsher than the game world he had left, as his family went broke having to pay his hospital bills all those years he lay in bed in a coma while stuck in the game. Pressed by loansharks, Suh decides to turn to what he does best... and logs back into the game, hoping to make enough money in the gaming world to convert it into real life currency and pay off the debt. To his pleasant surprise, Suh discovers that he gets to keep most of what he learned over 20 years of being stuck in the previous version of the game! This should be pretty easy... right?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Adele, a girl born in an orphanage and raised by her uncle, finds an egg in the forest. Little did she know, she has adopted herself a .charming dragon prince! After nine years of living under her wicked aunt and cousins who forced her into doing all the house chores, Adele's lifes turns upside down through the little boy that hatches out of a giant egg. Adele names the boy Zigmunt and takes care of him with love and care. Meanwhile, the Grand Duke Hernes and the Grand Wizard Jensen are in a desperate search for the lost dragon egg, from which the new emperor of the Bysen Empire. Adele's life turns upside down as she enters the Royal Palace with Zigmunt. That is only the beginning of this very special love story, one between the blood-thirsty dragon prince Zigmunt and his Adele.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Taking them in might have been a mistake... Or is it a blessing in disguise?

(Source: Toomics)

Joonhyuk, Minchul and Minjung have been close since they were young. Even when Minchul and Minjung start dating, Joonhyuk is never left out. But things get weird one drunken night when Minchul asks Joonhyuk if he wants to sleep with his girl. With her incredible curves and gorgeous looks, Minjung isn’t the kinda chick you’d wanna miss out on! Looks like these three friends are about to get a lot closer! 

(Source: Lezhin X)

A fresh-faced new recruit finds out that his girlfriend is cheating on him, and the devastating news plunges the poor soldier into a sleepless craze. His constant jerking off to his ex-girlfriend alarms the other soldiers, and soon the entire unit is made aware of the situation. Then one day, an unexpected visitor shows up...!

(Source: Lezhin X)

After a heroic death, Oh Youngsil is given the chance to select her own rebirth. With all the flavors of life before her, Youngsil forgoes all else and piles on one “scoop” of beauty after another. But there’s a catch. The choices she makes now take time off her life. To stop this, she is told she must give birth to “God’s Helper,” which will grant her wealth and happiness. Armed with beauty and not much else, will Youngsil taste the sweetness of life, or will reincarnation prove bittersweet? 

(Source: Tapas)

The spark is slowly fading from Sang-Hyun and Sun-Hee’s relationship, and they don’t know what to do. Luckily for them, the answer to all their problems is right in front of them—in the sex toy shop Sun-Hee’s been working at! Despite being a loyal employee, Sun-Hee’s never used any of the products herself. But, desperate needs call for desperate measures. Will the two manage to salvage their relationship? Let the sex toy try-outs begin!

(Source: Lezhin X)

"Soohyun’s not your average college student, considering his unfortunate circumstances. He’s always had bad luck, but even he didn’t expect to be sold off to and locked up at a secret, exclusive sex club where he’s used mercilessly by the clients against his will… It hasn’t always been like this for Soohyun. There was a time, long ago, when he was in love with a boy who was gentle and kind and loved by everyone… But little does Soohyun know, his past and present aren’t as separate as he thinks. When he runs into someone familiar at the club, all those memories are going to resurface in a whirlwind and riptide of emotions, and his past and present are going to come together… 

(Source: Lezhin US)

After a humiliating breakup, Kibum suffers from recurring nightmares of his cheating ex. But a new school year always comes with the added anticipation of romance, and Kibum is more than determined to spice up his love life once again!

(Source: Lezhin X)

display_title: Love is like the Weather Forecast
description:
It’s all rainy days for Ban Dong-Wook. Haunted by ghosts, he is unable to fall asleep no matter what he does. But one night, with Lee Do-Hyun by his side, he is able to clear his mind and drift off into dreamworld. Dong-Wook is convinced he needs Do-Hyun, but the latter is scared to love him in return. Will the two be able to work through the storm and find sunny days ahead? Or is the hurricane that is love destined to tear them apart?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Kensuke Yamamichi was enjoying a bit of solo camping when a group of girls suddenly came across his camp. Lost and unprepared for the cool nights, Kensuke offers to share his campsite with them. Cramped inside his tent and still drunk from a number of beers, things take a sexy turn for Kensuke, and again the next day at the hot springs. But this unforgettable night won’t stay in the past when it turns out he’s the girls’ new substitute teacher! 

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) 

*Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats.*

display_title: A Twist of Fate: A Wizard's Fairy Tale
description:
A young girl was neglected by her parents due to the belief that twins were bad luck to the point that she wasn't given a name. After losing her family and a few years of her memory, she was living an unfortunate life as a slave to a count's family. 

Then one day, a beautiful wizard who was called the strongest wizard in the world appeared before her eyes. The truth about her hidden past gradually comes to light. Their meeting will drastically change the fate of the world! 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

display_title: Can I Get Back Into Love With the Crown Prince?
description:
Baek-Ah aspired to become an idol, the day when she could stand on stage came near. While rehearsing for their debut, the ground suddenly shakes, the wall collapses, and she enters a different world through the portal of the clock tower.

The time when Baek-Ah fell into a fairytale book was the time when she suddenly become engaged to Prince Philip. That is why the world in the fairy tale has become chaotic.

In fact, Kairos, the country of Princess Sua, was just a small country without a princess. Therefore, without the support of the empire, it was on the verge of collapse. Philip took special care of Kairos by his own authority and waited for Sua to wake up. However, when Baek-Ah wakes up, she fails to remember the world in the book and disappoints Philip. Disappointed, he even brings up the story of breaking up.

The imperial family held a ball. On the surface, it was a place to socialize with the princesses of the subordinate country, but in fact, it is a 'place of confrontation' to find a fiancée again.... King Anno of Kairos asks Baek-Ah to save the kingdom and pushes Baek-Ah, who has not yet understood the situation, to attend the imperial ball. Baek-Ah goes there with her maid, Lindsey.

In the atmosphere of the ballroom, which is like a survival program, Baek-Ah shows off hers kills, saying that if you are an idol, you have to catch everyone's eyes in other worlds, and wants to be seen by Philip again.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

In the novel "My Dorothea," Maristella La Belflair is written as the titular character’s “dear friend,” but is more like her doormat. Ultimately executed due to Dorothea’s plot, she is given another chance at life after her death and is determined to survive this time. The problem is, she’s caught the eye of the male lead, Xavier, who is supposed to end up with Dorothea! With a love triangle and Dorothea’s schemes to deal with, can this former doormat step up to the challenges in her new life? 

(Source: Tapas)

Humanity has lost. By the end of World War Three, the R-virus has decimated 80% of the world’s population. To make matters worse, the virus transforms the infected into mindless monsters who crave human flesh, with some evolving into powerful beings with special powers called “Rayers”. The last remaining human settlements live in fear, their survival entirely dependent on the R-X, teenagers who have gained special abilities themselves through contact with Rayers. Wielding lethal weapons and supernatural abilities, the R-X fights to defend what little hope humanity has left. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Belle and the Beast's Labor Contract
description:
Belle isn't the classic beauty who falls in love and marries the Beast. She's a gunslinging tomboy who's out to revive her family's dying business, and love is nothing but a distraction to her. But when her father has a costly run-in with the local Beast, Belle is forced into a contract with the Beast himself in order to repay the debt. And thus, this "tale as old as time" takes a complicated twist. Despite the growing fondness the Beast has for Belle, our spitfire heroine refuses to fall in love! As outside forces begin to squeeze their way into the pair's lives, Belle and the Beast continue to clash over their views on romance. Will the two be able to close the distance between them to make it to the end of their contract? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

*"I don’t want to even breathe the same air as you!"*

...are the last words Jeong Sang-Heon says to Yun Hae-Sin before they part ways. But after ten years, the two reunite and end up living together under the same roof. Sang-Heon is the worst roommate one could have. He makes a mess wherever he goes, constantly breaks things, brings over uninvited guests, and even smokes inside the house. When Hae-Sin is at his wit’s end, he finally finds out a weakness that helps him put a leash around Sang-Heon's neck. Will Hae-Sin successfully tame Sang-Heon so that they can live in peace together while breathing the same air? 

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Mirae recently got into a marriage of comfort with an older man. She's now got a cushy and stable lifestyle as a housewife that suits her just fine. That is until one day, her husband’s adult son Hyunsoo, abruptly returns home from abroad and moves back in. To Mirae, Hyunsoo feels like an uninvited guest in her house. Now with the sudden news that Mirae’s two voluptuous sisters are also planning on moving in, will all of these temptations and titillations under one roof be too much? 

(Source: Lezhin X)

*‘Is… is this really my wife?’<

* Too drunk to recognize who’s fucking her, Taegun felt a strange eroticism while watching his wife shaking her ass.

(Source: Lezhin X)

From losing her family to being mistreated by her in-laws and executed for crimes they forced her to commit, life was cruel to Guinevere Le Pur… Pitied by fate, Guinevere is given the chance to go back in time and learns that she was cheated out of her husband’s bequeathed wealth. Now, she’s determined to take back her stolen fortune and make sure her tormentors get absolutely nothing. But will Guinevere get her revenge, or will she walk down the fiery path of misery once again? 

(Source: Tapas)

There’s something on Taejoon’s mind. He’s been dating Yeona long enough that they know each other’s bodies inside and out, but something's missing. Something that’ll add a thrill to their perfect relationship: a threesome. However, when he finally brings the topic up, Yeona threatens to break up with him. That only piques his interest in the forbidden topic, and he soon comes up with a plan to go through with his ultimate fantasy.

(Source: Lezhin X)

Re-discovering forgotten memories. 

Navy was aged backward and lost her memories of when she was an adult. After a tragic fire that resulted in a death, she finds that her savior and friend has mysteriously cut her off. Now she is trying to reconnect with her friend and find out what really happened in the fire. 

(Source: Manta)

Mr. Ju’s thirst for women is never ending. Morning, noon, or night, any time of the day is a welcome opportunity to whet his appetite. However, his father, the chairman, has finally had enough. He’s hired a new secretary to whip Mr. Ju into shape and hopefully get him to take his job more seriously. Ms. Kang is all business and has quite a skillset. However, there is far more to Ms. Kang than meets the eye. Mr. Ju and Ms. Kang are about to get entangled in affairs they could never have predicted…

(Source: Lezhin X)

Come heal and find love in Jeju! 

3rd-generation Korean-American Brenda falls in love with Jeju Island while researching its female divers. She decides to take the plunge and move to the island with her husband. There, she dives deep into Jeju's history and culture while healing, growing, and building friendships along the way. 

(Source: Manta)

A writer wrote steamy adult stories starring a Demon King. Now he wants justice!

In order to avoid execution, the writer must make half the contents of her novel, a collection of lust and desire, come true! But wait, she is supposed to re-enact all the scenes, as the female lead, while the Demon King acts out the male lead???? Living in a world of demons, caught by its monarch and engaged in steamy role play! Let the games begin!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Do Sulmi was so excited to start her new life as a freshman at Hanguk University, but she’s quickly discouraged after being incessantly bullied by her classmates for her looks and weight. Baek Dojoon on the other hand, has always been incredibly handsome and wildly popular amongst his peers. They’re both students in the Genetic Engineering program, which is in possession of the “Transbody,” a state-of the art machine that allows the user to change their human form into whatever they choose. After a late-night accident in the lab with the Transbody, Dojoon is left with an affliction where each night he involuntarily changes into a beautiful woman. Sulmi would do anything to escape her current body while Dojoon would do anything to return permanently to his old one. Will Sulmi and Dojoon be able to transform their fates and find a happy ending? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Help me escape from this place. Nokram is a utopia, its citizens happy and smiling… except for Juri, who sees a paradox in the facade of happiness. At her school’s graduation, she stumbles upon a dark secret, and after a failed escape, she is saved by a girl with mysterious abilities. Will this new hero be the key to her way out? 

(Source: Manta)

The antics of an unsuspecting, new apartment complex committee planner, and the comic swarm of headache-inducing women he must now deal with.

(Source: Toomics)

Graduate students Garib and Jin-Joo, who study insects, are a couple who have been dating for a long time since they were freshmen. Boredom comes to them, who have lived together for over 3 years. One day, trembling in fear that Garib would leave him, Jin-Joo let an unknown insect sting his finger, Libidine, who had just entered the laboratory. Jin-Joo suddenly starts to get an erection in front of Garib, who reassures him that nothing will happen, and Garib, a graduate student who gets excited because of this unusual phenomenon, begins to glow. Meanwhile, their advisor 'Coral' and assistant 'Bada' also find out Libidine's secret. They embark on a plan to use Libidine to fuck each other...

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

I'm ready for my zero waste life! 

After relying on fast food and alcohol for too long, a health scare pulls our heroine into the world of "Zero Waste." But her attempts to improve her own health, as well as the health of the planet, start causing issues with the people around her. Is living a zero waste life really possible? 

(Source: Manta)

Hae-On is a K-pop idol who never made it big. His career is halfway dead and his life is a bleak and boring grind. But one day, things start looking up. His career is kickstarted into life as he gains gigs and popularity. His life starts to become vibrant and busy. He’s finally about to become a true star. 

Except, something dangerous is lurking around the corner. Somebody is following him. Watching him. On the brink of dragging him into darkness entirely. And once you’re trapped in the dark, it’s almost impossible to escape… 

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Catching Two Birds with One Sweet Princess
description:
After awakening in a webnovel as Princess Clara, this former office worker isn’t getting the royal treatment. As the shy sister of the tyrannical King Bastian, she’s immediately faced with disdain and so much drama! Plus her character's destined to be seduced by his latest hostage, Crown Prince Daniel, accused of betrayal, and executed. But Clara’s got a backbone and a plan to win over her brother. She’s ready to take control, slap some sense into meddling nobles and servants, and resist the charms of her handsome (really handsome) charge! 

(Source: Tapas)

Hara gets handpicked to work as secretary to the CEO, "trained" by his own ambitious nephew, Han Seung-ho. It's a dangerous game of seduction and workplace politics - one that demands careful treading on Hara's part. But while she skillfully lays out the honey trap, she too seems to have her own cards up her sleeve. How does she manage to do it all? By selling whatever she has to sell.

(Source: Lezhin X)

In 2009, a resident of a small mountain village is shot and killed, and this murder leads to a series of sinister events. Jeong-U Cho, a boy who was born and raised in the village, begins to feel a mysterious gaze on him, and finds himself caught up in an uncontrollable disaster. 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

*"Do you want me to sleep?"*

I was suffocated by her boobs. I wished time would just stop like this... And time really stopped.

(Source: Lezhin X)

Kim Yoonsung was a regular guy living a happy life with his family. That is until he discovers he is a “Trace,” a class of mutant humans with special abilities who emerged to fight the mysterious monsters known as “Troubles,” who threaten Earth. Shunned by ordinary humans, many Traces live in hiding. That’s what Yoonsung intended to do, but when his family is suddenly taken from him, he is forced to team up with a wild crew of Traces to find them. Little does he know what “troubles” lie ahead. 

(Source: Tapas)

Sally and Devin are a married couple with a son in college. Devin loses his job and leaves Sally no choice, but to start supporting the family herself.

(Source: Toomics)

Yeong-Jun, who has been living a perfectionist life until now, meets Tae-Eun through an anonymous chat after quitting his company. During their first meeting, seeing Tae-Eun staggering while drunk, Yeong-Jun is drawn to his imperfection...

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

When two lovers are bound by the red thread of fate, they are destined to be together forever. But what happens when the thread binds three people together? Hyena Kim and Huiyeong Lee are two souls who have reincarnated countless times throughout history, falling in love only to be torn apart by tragedy in each life. That is, until one day, Huiyeong’s soul is split into two by a servant of Grandma Samsin, the deity of lovers. With the red thread of fate tying Hyena to both halves of Huiyeong, who will she choose for her chance at everlasting love? 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

An U-Yeong is a 20-year-old who wants to have a wonderful relationship. He starts dating the senior he has dreamed of, just like he wanted. But... why is he always gasping for breath with a stranger every time they happen to meet?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

All I wanted was to learn my father-in-law's business, but I seem to be learning more than that from him!

(Source: Toomics)

A hot guy appears with drugs?! 

Plagued by health issues, Bo-Ni Min is basically a walking hospital. Then one day a mysterious guy appears. He moves in, gives her medicine, and explains them all to her. Turns out the information is quite useful! Soon enough, Bo-Ni finds herself falling for his cold-but-warm-hearted charms... 

(Source: Manta, edited)

Jake, a struggling, jobless man, cannot afford to pay his rent. As his landlady pressures him on, he finds other ways to pay her back...

(Source: Toomics)

I have everything that I ever wanted. A big house, a nice job, and even a beautiful fiancée... However, ever since I ran into my first love, I would give it all up to be with her, even if it means cheating on my best friend...

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

Kim Ga-Yeong is the best-selling author of "Office Misconduct," a story based on her first job experience five years ago. Ga-Yeong's dreams to start her new job are shattered as she learns how tough the workplace can be. After being forced to take on unreasonable job requests and severe bullying from her supervisor, Na-Yeon, Ga-Yeong decides to kill her. But her plans suddenly change when someone else murders Na-Yeon first. She's positive the culprit is from the office, but the question is, who? 

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Despite his good looks, Seungdo has built a wall around himself. No matter who tries to get close to him - nor how hard they try - no one has ever succeeded. Yet, when Horang appears in his life, determined to shatter those barriers, a captivating tale of determination and devotion unfolds. Will Horang's unwavering resolve be the key to unlocking Seungdo's heart? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

When your dad brings home a significantly younger woman to introduce her as your new stepmother, it’s pretty normal to disapprove of the whole deal. And it’s pretty standard to hate this new woman invading your household. That’s exactly what Sung-Hoon plans to do when he meets Yeoni, his dad’s girlfriend, but…he really wasn’t counting on how hot she is, or how determined she is to befriend him. What do you do when your relationship with your sexy stepmom-to-be gets increasingly steamier? Time to come…and find out!

(Source: Lezhin X, edited)

Most people are apprehensive when Monday comes around, but for Han Jin, a senior associate at SH Corporation, it’s for a slightly different reason. Something takes over him every Monday, and he calls it his “Monday self.” From confessing his feelings to buying luxury items, Han’s Monday self helps him gain confidence, and soon enough, he makes a name for himself in the workplace. As problems arise, Han seeks help from his Monday self and colleagues, but he eventually realizes that in order to succeed, he has to start trusting in himself.

(Source: Tapas)

The young president of the Dibicci bank, Lawrence Dibicci, controls the economic world of the Cosimo Empire. One day, a girl named Rahui is thrown under his wings instead of her father's debt.

(Source: Copin Comics)

Eight years ago, Jisu Bahn was named the most promising talent on stage. Forgotten over the years, she grows more desperate for her big break. When she is approached by Hayle Tou, a mysteriously wealthy and irresistibly handsome man, she feels her next chapter in life will be a glamorous one with this man. One fateful night, they finally kiss. The very next day, everything changes in Jisu's life. 

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Muyoung has depended on Heewon for a long time. But he’s had enough of freeloading and wants to break out on his own. The only problem is, is that Muyoung’s an omega who is having a hard time finding a good job. Plus, his excessive pheromone problem isn’t helping. Life for an omega isn’t easy. But one day, Heewon proposes a way for Muyoung to reduce his excessive pheromone symptoms. All it requires is for an omega to mate with an alpha. And all Heewon desires is to make Muyoung be unable to live without him… 

(Source: Lezhin US)

What is every Korean guy’s worst nightmare? Re-enlistment! Minho can’t believe it. He’s already 30 years old but he has to go back to the military! But he’s not just gonna take this lying down! With the help of his lawyer, he’ll be able to get out of his military duties and be back to civilian life in no time. But wait a second… All of his comrades in his new unit are women…from the commander to the doctor! Well, on second thought, this might not be so bad after all…

(Source: Lezhin X)

When Mongolian troops threaten to invade a village, an unexpected warrior may be the key to saving its residents.

(Source: Toomics)

A girl from the modern world aspiring to become a pop idol slips into the body of Ashley Verrence, the main villainess of the novel she was reading. In the original story, Ashley was a crown princess who lost favor with the prodigal crown prince and ended up being executed. 

The new Ashley has one year to change her destiny and her first steps towards a new future start with preparing a play using her modern knowledge. Can she make amends and escape her death? 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

"Hyeok-su’s never given that much thought into this own future. He never concentrates in class, he’s been kicked out of the basketball team, his father’s always thinking up a wild investment plan—he knows he won’t amount to much, so why bother? After he finds out that participating in viral brawls is a better investment than studying, he dedicates his entire attention to that “sport.” However, one day he discovers another sport that’ll benefit him in the long run. Ice hockey. How difficult could it be? It’s just swinging some sticks around on ice, isn’t it?

(Source: Lezhin X)

Jooah, Hyunah and Yeoim are university students who are in relationships. Jooah has a handsome and perfect boyfriend but is disheartened by the fact that he prioritizes his work before her, Hyunah has been in a relationship with her boyfriend long enough that it has become boring and has thrown a sweet, soft and heart fluttering romance to the dogs, Yeoim struggles with complicated family circumstances and an immature boyfriend. Who said that romance in the twenties is only flashy and beautiful! Getting hurt and giving hurt, there's nothing as clumsy and unstable... This love like war that makes one feel like they are flying in the sky and then brings them crashing down to ground. The bittersweet love story of three female protagonist unfolds!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/56621460), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/297063475), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000059949), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10347892), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=230986), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/salad_days)

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://www.ebookrenta.com/renta/sc/frm/item/145962), [Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/173660)    
Spanish: Pentacomix, [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.es/detail/dias-de-juventud)

Returning students Jae-Seong and Da-Yeon are an ordinary couple, but little by little a gap arises between them. Then Jae-Seong gets to know the girl next door who looks like the adult movie star he’s always dreamed of.

(Toomics, translated)

His blessing changed my life. 

Kate knows full well that orphan girls don't get fairy tale endings. But when she saves the kidnapped daughter of Count Blanc, she's given the opportunity of a lifetime: becoming a maidservant at the Blanc Estate. There, she meets Alex, the cold but dashing heir whom she mistakes as a priest... 

(Source: Manta)

'Will you kill me? Shall I kill everything that confronts my master?' I met a devilish man in the mansion where I moved in as a helper as if running away from violence and looting. And suddenly, a strange whistling sound is heard. The watcher's gaze towards me and the strange rituals gradually catch my breath.

Purgatory Funeral Cakes follows Baker Mago and her ghost assistant, Miro, who craft funeral cakes based on stories shared by the loved ones of the deceased. In this world, it is believed that souls must endure 49 days in purgatory before reaching reincarnation, and the cakes serve as a comfort during this period.

“You may be rich, but that doesn’t mean you can just do whatever you want with others!” A young man with nothing to lose will do anything to rise to the top.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Ji-Ae is a gorgeous lady who gets to live a comfortable life as a trophy wife, but her life isn't all sparkles and joy.

(Source: Toomics, edited)

Humans have always been hunters, and at times they’ve even hunted other humans. KH-7, the latest android and a government agent, has awoken in such a world. In this dystopia where the Intelligence Division rules supreme and “log tracers” collect terrorists’ memories, KH-7 serves to impart justice. But with no grasp on his real identity and only vague memories of “Eternity Land,” his deceased wife, and their taken child, he sets out for vengeance and his past, only to discover some unsettling truths...

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: My Wife is a Female Teacher
description:
Lee Seonah lives a lavish lifestyle with her husband, but her father forced her to become a teacher. As she works in this school, she can't help but notice that the teaching staff has high libido. Seonah's teaching job led her to reconnect with her ex, which rekindled a sensual flame

(Source: INKR)

display_title: Paradise of Sinners: An Encyclopedia of Gods
description:
Humans are prone to sin. Thus, the gravest sinners are drawn from the earth to live out a sentence of divinity, eternal life, and atonement in a gloomy paradise where desserts are the only consolation. Ursula is brought to paradise against her will to serve as the record keeper. She must now venture through the fragmented memories of the other gods and record the stories of their mortal past. 

The sinners who enter paradise are wiped of their memories. Hence, the recordkeeper must find and record the stories of the gods who spend their immortal days repenting their sins on earth. Ursula enters rooms of their memories and discovers their sins and how they end up in paradise. The encyclopedia is Ursula’s record of the lives, deaths, and stories of gods and their mortal past.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

Everyone has different tastes. An old school friend of Ha Na-Yeon hired her to seduce her husband. His preferences in sex life are strange to Ha Na-Yeon, but she will do anything to achieve the goal and earn a lot of money.

(Source: Toomics, translated)

After his career as a pro baseball coach ends in disgrace, Jung Min-Yong comes to Dongcheon High School to whip the baseball team into shape. With his no-nonsense teaching style, the players are pushed to their limits, and when a gifted newbie is recruited to the team, the existing players are forced to face just how much they still have to learn. With Coach Jung laying down one reality check after another, will the players call it quits? Or will it be enough motivation to let their gifts shine?

(Source: Tapas)

*“I never imagined I'd be climbing trees like this...”* 

After a devastating nuclear war, humanity abandons land for safety among the treetops. However, what they don't realize is that they're not alone. Mysterious creatures of unknown origin lurk behind every branch... Will they be friends? Or a new kind of foe? 

(Source: Comikey)

I got caught jerking off while looking at my brother's hot wife.

*"Sis, can I please, just touch it once?"* 

But to my surprise, she came on to me instead! Just what is going on?!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

After being frustrated with her husband for a while, Summer finally resolves the problem. But who's the person lying next to her?! 

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: To You Who Doesn't Love Me
description:
Ages ago in a land of myth and legend, a young girl called Rose stands tied to a stake, awaiting her cruel fate as a sacrifice to the sea serpent known as Leviathan. That is, until a dashing hero suddenly appears to defeat the monster and save Rose’s life.
