Eternally grateful, Rose becomes devoted to her rescuer Mikhail, who is the demigod son of the moon goddess, Diana. She joins his party of adventurers, but soon comes to realize that her savior may not be as noble as he seems… 

(Source: Webtoons)

Lee Jisoo has one goal in life: to destroy Chairman Jung the same way he destroyed her family. While trying to get dirt on Jung’s private life, she runs into Moon Hyun-soo, the CEO of an investment company. Much to Jisoo’s surprise, Hyun-soo offers to help her with her scheme. Without knowing Hyun-soo’s hidden agenda, Jisoo decides to trust him and form a secret partnership. Will this promise born from revenge turn into something more?

(Source: Lezhin X)

Do Jung-hoon is powerful, ruthless, and…fond of a lovely face. So, when pretty-boy Yoo Hyunjae joins the Sung Jin gang, Jung-hoon finds it hard to believe the rumors about this supposedly dangerous and unpredictable newbie. Getting Hyunjae into his bed is as easy as promising a way to the top, but one year later, Hyunjae mysteriously vanishes. The only message he leaves is a cryptic “I will miss you, hyung.” Jung-hoon barely has time to think about the anxious feeling growing in his stomach when his gang is viciously attacked by an unknown enemy. But then, a voice comes from the shadows…

 *“Long time no see, hyung.”* 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Editor's Comment: This comic contains scenes of violence, bodily harm, and criminal conduct throughout. Reader discretion is advised *

*Note: The chapter count includes nine chapter side story and four special chapters.***

This wasn't something I thought I'd teach someone!

(Source: Toomics)

Can you find love in a virtual world? Narae doesn’t really believe in love. BBQ restaurant owner by day and romance novelist by night, she’s too busy with work to pursue a relationship. When she gets a strange text that offers her the chance to find true love, she accepts it as a joke - until she actually ends up in a game. Will she be able to escape.. and find true love along the way?

(Source: Manta)

This gorgeous, divorced lady is the girl I used to play with when I was a kid?!

(Source: Toomics)

Taeyoung’s always treated girls like crap. But after waking up one day to find a “lady-hole” on his ribcage, he slowly starts to gain a deeper understanding of the female experience. And luckily (or not) his ex-girlfriend is on-hand to speed up the process. Join Lizzy as she drags Taeyoung on a depraved journey of sexual discovery… 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ehwa Corporation’s Oh Bitna has it all: a great career in the lingerie business, a loving fiancé, Lee Sangcheol, and a stellar reputation. However, everything comes crashing down when she finds Sangcheol is cheating on her, has stolen her promotion and even besmirched her stellar reputation! But Bitna isn’t one to go down easy. Not without getting something in return, that is. Revenge is a dish best served cold but Bitna is here to make it steaming hot and dressed in frills and laces! She joins ranks with Seo Jihun, the owner of Ehwa’s rival company, to take Ehwa down. But revenge isn’t the only thing in the works it seems… Bitna and Jihun are falling for each other. Will Bitna let her feelings for Jihun sway her or will she remain steadfast on her path for revenge?

(Source: Lezhin US)

I don't know where it went wrong. Was it from the first meeting? Yeah, that day... Everything may have already begun to go against from the moment decided to go to my daughter's room.

(Source: Lezhin X)

Jackson's girlfriend returns after months of no contact as someone else's wife...!

(Source: Toomics)

Kevin must settle for less, having given up his long time crush to his best friend. But Kevin’s new girlfriend occupies him in unexpected ways.

(Source: Toomics)

"Yoo-Yeon chances upon the Middle World Sauna." 

In this place regarded as the waypoint and resting place at the center of all worlds, she meets the mysterious man Myo Wol... 

(Source: Comikey)

A romantic thriller exploring the dark corners of human desire and isolation with quiet eeriness. 

Is a fresh start truly possible? Or will society’s strictures and your own impulses keep re-creating the same messed-up relationships in every narrow room you enter? 

Choi Seongmin’s Narrow Rooms follows a young woman who leaves her rural hometown to study in Seoul and seek self-improvement. But once there, she quickly becomes the target of unwanted attention from her teacher, and the whispers of other students only deepen her alienation. Living in a cramped, poorly soundproofed room, the suffocating atmosphere begins to further distort her boundaries and perceptions. Longing for escape, she fixates on a handsome new neighbor, her fascination spiraling into obsession: She secretly rummages through his mailbox, collects his discarded cigarette butts and teabags, and hoards his trash. But when she discovers something unsavory about the object of her desire, will she be forced to confront the morals of her own behavior? 

(Source: Drawn & Quarterly)

Na Kang-Rim is a high school student who generally likes webtoons. One day, he experiences something bizarre: the female main character from a webtoon he often reads appeared before him. 

The incidents that happened in the webtoon started happening in the real world too, but the problem is that there is no hero to save her this time! So Kang-Rim decides to become the hero and save her. 

(Source: Naver, translated)

While working as a small supporting actor in a movie, Ki Man-Seong has nothing else going for him. However, that was when, through mysterious circumstances, the movie set had become reality during filming. With the sound of the director’s cut, during that short take, he’s not an actor but actually thrown into the events occurring, showing the pain and emotions he faces at that moment. He can only come back if he creates that perfect take…! Can he grow to become the greatest actor?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Army veteran's last go at the obstacle course turns lethal after a simple fall. A goddess presents an opportunity at new life as a hero! The protagonist ain't having any of it, he was supposed to retire and become a civilian. The arrogant Goddess drops him down to survive while having her own evil schemes. How will his new life progress after encountering another Goddess, a spy and his past life's junior?

The genius lawyer No Hyeong-Jin's justice-executing returner fantasy! Valedictorian of his University, perfect score on the Bar Exam, and even a 95% case win rate. No Hyeong-Jin was a so-called successful lawyer! While he was fighting against evil, higher powers to make South Korea a just and fair land, he was ruthlessly murdered by National Intelligence Service agents.

*"He shouldn't have died..."*

No Hyeong-Jin was a man sent by Emperor Yeom-Ra to fix corruption on Earth! However, after ending up in hell without having been able to achieve anything, Emperor Yeom-Ra returns No Hyeong-Jin back in time... What is this "power" given to him by Emperor Yeom-Ra? Will No Hyeong-Jin be able to change his future as well as the future of South-Korea?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Mun Ga-Ya who suffered from childhood trauma. At the newly transferred school, he meets Cha Ae-Ri, the perfect model student and the beloved queen. Ga-Ya gradually falls in love with this dangerous and beautiful woman, and something inside that has been suppressed begins to awaken. 

*‘Can we be free in this hell?’* 

(Source: Naver, translated) 

*Note: The chapter count includes an epilogue.*

Dam-Ho, the sole survivor of a raid on his village, has a lame leg, the worst possible condition for a martial artist. Nonetheless, he refuses to stop training. Whilst everyone around him tells him he cannot become one, Dam-Ho refuses to give up on this dream. Will he really be able to overcome his misfortune and become the best martial artist? 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*“You have been chosen as a player in the great game to select the next god’s successor, the Mission! Congratulations!”*
Seong-Hoon has suddenly fallen into another world to participate in a game to become a god. This other world that is akin to that of a game contains players who cooperate and also kill each other in cold blood…!! Seong-Hoon, a person without an ounce of talent, uses wicked and crude tricks to become an all-powerful player!

(Source: Naver, translated)

One day, a mysterious virus spreads through the city of Seoul in the form of mutant cells that keep multiplying. When people come into contact with these cells, they turn into hideous and dripping creatures that can infect others at any time. 

Yeon-U, who is on a school trip to Seoul, is excited at the thought of getting closer to So-Yeon, a classmate whom he had a crush on. But for Yeon-U and his classmates, the trip soon turns into a nightmare. In order to survive, these high school students must find a way to escape the city before it is completely engulfed by the virus.

Various secrets are uploaded anonymously every day in the school's anonymous application.
Min-Jun, who is in love with Ha-young unrequitedly for 10 years, has all the anonymous posts appearing as real names due to an error and finds out the shocking fact that Ha-young's boyfriend 'Ki-ju' is cheating.

(Source: Naver, translated and edited)

A bossy CEO gets reincarnated as a busker and runs into our innocent main character. Coincidentally, the company where the main character works at belongs to the CEO's family. What will happen to them now?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

*“Who’s this male prostitute-looking kid?”* 

I am the matchless Ha Hu-Yeong, the greatest martial artist reigning over all the lands! There is no one that is my equal! I was drowning in futility and emptiness because there was no more that I could accomplish in the human realm. To reach the peak of martial arts, I must become a saint!
However, the other saints refused my ascension due to my karma after much slaughter, and I fell, just like that. 

When I woke up, I was 60 years in the future. I was reborn as the second lord of the Namgung family: Namgung Hyuk. Where has all the internal energy that I’ve accumulated gone?! Moreover, I have the Nine yin energy blockage? 

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
*Note: Chapter count includes nine side story chapters.*

Betting on TaeHwa Group's future, an A.I. created for diagnosis named Baruda! First-year neurosurgeon President Lee Soohyuk was working with Baruda when he was hit by a mysterious explosion and lost consciousness. After regaining consciousness, he met the A.I. Baruda inside his mind. Already inseparable, they are faced with a situation where they must help each other.

Baruda, who, through deep learning, aims to become the best diagnoser, and Soohyuk, who still aims to come into his own, work together to become the world's best neurosurgeon.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Ha-Min, who is worried about her introverted and timid personality, meets some unusual people at the cafe 'Rendezvous'. 

A spicy and emotional sitcom about 28-year-old friends! 

(Source: Naver, translated)

Only after Empress Lizzie died did Emperor Leon realize his foolishness and regretted it too late, but the time had already passed. 

With Leon's wishes, the Witch of the Clock Tower turned back time to the day Leon first met Empress Lizzie, and all Leon had to do, after returning to the past, was to make Lizzie happy. 

But the influence of turning back time was greater than he thought. Will Leon be able to make a happy ending with Lizzie this time?

(Source: Naver, translated)

The school's three most popular guys are actually someone's exasperating brothers—and someone who loathes attention at that! Haejoo craves a life of mundanity and obscurity, but she's plagued by her three jaw-droppingly handsome brothers who stand out even when they're doing nothing more exciting than breathing. At school, she goes to great lengths to hide the fact that they're related, but what happens when she finally gets busted? Will Haejoo be able to achieve the quiet life she seeks despite being stuck in a school with her three older brothers?

(Source: Naver, translated)

The story of Kim JaeHan starts now! A dad who only has eyes for his daughter faces a sudden death. His mission is now to protect his daughter DaHyun from the 12 bullies by using his powerful character from webtoon drawing when he was once alive! As a dad, he’ll never let his daughter get bullied. If he sees this?… he won’t let those bullies alone. Whoever touches my daughter, you’re fucked.

The three kingdoms, the era where heroes flocked in order to defeat the world. The best-armed follicles got lost in history due to a momentary mistake. The last moments of life… 

*“Give me one more chance, I promise I’ll defeat the world!”* 

When I opened my eyes, the follicle was in its twenties. It went back in time, with its tumultuous spirit beginning to unfold! 

(Source: Kakao, translated)

An unknown voice disturbed me while I was levitating during my cultivation to reach the transcendent demonic state. 

My concentration had been broken, and I fell into an unconscious, overloaded state. When I awoke a month later, the Lich King had already taken control of the Murim. 

After the battle that ended with the destruction of the Heavenly Demon Cult, I awoke a hundred and forty years later in a Murim where magic and martial arts coexisted.

A dizzying office love affair between an S-class esper and a B-class guide! Lee Jaeha, a B-class guide, had an office relationship with an esper at the same center for 3 years, but was recently done wrong. Despite breaking up with his lover, he finds himself forced to still guide him, and he applies for a transfer to a high-risk area. Surrounded by all kinds of rumors and stares, all he wants is a quiet and peaceful work life in the new center! However, Jaeha takes on the task of guiding Do Jiyoon, an S-class esper, on the verge of a rampage, and Jaeha’s work life is getting farther away from peaceful…!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

A child was abandoned in a forest infested with monsters and ghosts. Woon Sowol was adopted by the five masters and learned the best magical techniques. Although the five masters are godly beings, now their inner balance is on the verge of being broken down. Woon Sowol takes revenge on behalf of his masters, and goes to the world to become a god. In the end, will Sowol be able to get out of the forest of beasts? 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Nervous and excited, Sae-Beom, 20 years old, moves into a share-house, in spring before her first year in college. There she meets Hee-Joo, a roommate with a unique personality, and even a Choi Ra-Wook look-alike. It's a story about the lives of our enthusiastic, immature, 20 year old selves! Would you like to come to our share house full of the first love excitements?

Gyeoul, a friend from the same class, always maintains proper posture. For some reason, Gyeoul keeps catching Yohan's attention. Suddenly, the two of them become deskmates. Just like the physical distance, their hearts get closer. This loud heartbeat. What should we call the rising blush of that face? A clueless boy and girl's first love story.

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: I Met the Male Lead in Prison
description:
One day, I opened my eyes and found myself in... prison?! 

That's right. Out of all the characters I could've reincarnated into, I woke up inside a 19+ rated romance novel as the villain's younger sister. To make things even worse, I was locked up inside the infamous Kambrakam Prison for my brother's crimes. 

Deep within the very same prison lies Henrich Doran von Hel, who's rumored to be suffering from a curse that turns him into a beast. In the original novel, he's supposed to meet the female lead and spend an erotic night with her here in prison... but of course, the plot's gone awry thanks to my existence. What kind of future lies in store for me now that I've gotten myself tangled up between the novel's greatest villain and its male lead?!

(Source: Kakao Webtoons, translated)

Is he crazy? Or just the typical attention seeker? 

Lee Gang-Jin, who doesn't understand the differences between people, and his Master Kwak-No who's the one helping him to understand the differences between people. 

A warm human story of a student and his Master.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The social outcast, Seria, had changed. 

Seria Shuteren, the vile woman who had everyone trembling with fear at her feet, was now calm. Truthfully, the woman had not just changed; she was a completely different person. Realizing she had possessed the wicked woman's body in this romance novel, she decided to live on the low, having a hunch about the future. 

She would end Seria's dreadful habits and successfully avoid her death by decapitation at the hands of Kalis, the sub male lead!

A world full of zombies. But this apocalypse... is it worth trying?! Mental care, wooden construction, heavenly magic, animal communication, mechanical engineering, performance, etc... There is so much to learn! 

The sprint of the prepared survivor, who is good at everything, begins! 

(Source: Naver, translated)

I don’t want to work. Like at all. But I don’t have a choice. On an Earth where Humans, Elves, Orcs, Trolls, Dragons, and Aliens live together, there is a never-ending series of incidents. This is the story of a man that’s had to work in secrecy for 800 years because he’ll die if he doesn’t.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Jisoo, who dreamed of becoming a fairy tale illustrator since she was young, dropped out to achieve her dream and went to her grandmother's house, where she meets Dowon.

Dowon, who was worried about not having a dream, is interested in Jisoo who is trying hard to achieve her dream.

"The farther you try to catch, the farther away you feel. When will the day you reach your dream come?"

College student So-Yi Han has been unable to move on from the lingering affection she has for her ex-boyfriend. She tries to sort out her complicated feelings by concentrating on her studies, and receives a flower pot from a local elder to use for a class at school. But little does she know, the pot she receives happens to be a cursed pot, where a man's soul is trapped... 

(Source: Naver, translated)

*What would you do if your e-girl was a boy? Find out Hee-Jae's reaction!*

One year ago, I was a world-class player in the game Arcana. However, everything I built up was destroyed by Hee-Jae Shin as easily as a sandcastle. I sold my account at a high price and decided to never set foot in the game again... Even if I quit now, it doesn't mean I quit for good though, right? One year later, I made a new account just like following a homing instinct. 

*The Grand Mage comes back as a young girl!*

*Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.*

display_title: A Match Made in the Past
description:
*"The King was killed by his own concubine?!"*
Min-Ju suddenly remembered her past life while taking an exam. She was very embarrassed when she remembered but tried to calm down because the most important thing in that moment was her college entrance examination and not her previous life. However, Hu-Gang, who was her husband from the previous life, appeared. Min-Ju's life is in a crisis now. 

*"Forget about the past life, Min-Ju. Hurry up and study!!"* 

*Note:
\- Includes a Prologue.
\- Part of YLAB's Red String Universe.*

While on the way to work, Yuji Shin saw a swallow lying weakly on the road. I hate the bothersome things, but I can't pass over the injured swallow and heal the wounds and take care of them. However, the reality is that I am a college student who is tight enough to deal with my body, so I will soon return the swallow... 

*“Don’t forget Park when you come again… “* 

The swallow, who just flew to the mountain spirit, asks for Mr. Park so that he can repay his grace, but the time is already in the 21st century. Mr. Park, who will repay his favor, is dry. 

*“What about Park, just get rid of it with her body!!”* 

Will the swallow be able to safely return the grace to Yuji? A project to repay the full-fledged grace of the Swallows who came to fill them with their bodies because Park wasn't there!

Do-Yeon and Eun-Ha, who became a family due to their parents' remarriage, become strangers again due to their parents' divorce. When the two meet again after many years. Eun-Ha is obsessed with Do-Yeon, and Do-Yeon is burdened by his younger brother... What's even worse is that his feelings for Eun-Ha are not 'brotherly love'.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

One day, an ordinary college student, Kim Ji-Yong, begins to see Jung Jung-Hye in his dreams.After falling in love with her at first sight, Kim tries to find her, but it turns out she was... She committed suicide two years ago!
A bittersweet romance in which Kim Ji-Yong struggles to save her life. Show up, right in front of me!

(Source: Naver, translated) 

*Note: Chapter count includes 19 extras.*

“It looks the same as the ideal type in your imagination!” 

One spring day when cherry blossoms are in full bloom, “Bo-Mi,” a freshman in high school who was alone in an empty art department, she pours all her ideals and draws a fictional character, surprised to learn that the person in my imagination looks the same as Hae-Yoon, a handsome, tall, athletic senior in the nation’s rankings for the practice test. Hae-Yoon appears in front of Bo-Mi, who is worried about the infringement of her portrait rights, and Bo-Mi is thrilled at Hae-Yoon's request to continue drawing herself... 

(Source: Peanutoon)

Ahn Si-Yoon, a pitcher who does not hesitate to play the role of a losing team if it is possible to play baseball. After continuing his junior high school career with poor results, his baseball life begins to change when he meets 'Baek Tae-oh', a catcher of the opposing team. 

(Source: Naver, translated)

One day, a circus troupe came across the street from Eden's school. Passing by the barracks, Eden meets the ring master of the troupe, Luke. Eden, who feels guilty for Luke for a certain childhood incident, recognizes him at one glance. However, Luke does not recognize him, and Eden felt upset leads him to getting drunk at the circus welcome party. The two accidentally spend a passionate night and quickly become close. Enamoured by Eden's cute and unguarded natural, Luke, who has lived a prosperous and carefree life so far, can't stop himself from falling for him. Eden is also attracted to Luke, who has grown up to be serious and cool, unlike when his young self, but the rumours about him being a Casanova leave him uneasy.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

display_title: A Love Story Of A Person
description: A deep love that I wanted to try even if I was in pain, hurt and resigned. I had an unexpected encounter when I thought I wasn't lucky. Will it be love this time?

"Congratulations on being born."

Once I opened my eyes, I was in a cold laboratory. I wasn't born because I wasn't human, I was created, but she still celebrates it nevertheless.

I learned how to live by drinking coffee together, smelling the scent, hearing the sound of decoration shaking due to the wind, and becoming close to the rabbit who often came to visit the garden.

However...

"Actually, in a week from now, I'm going to die."

She, who neither complains about pain or reveals her pain, is calm, but why does my heart hurt so much? I was also a person who could shed tears.

"Why did you create me? Why did you make me like you?"

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Is this a dream…? 

When Ji-Woo wakes up in the rippling water, the first thing he sees is someone he’d never seen before between his legs. Embarrassed, he tries to get out, but somehow his body cannot move, and the person who took off his pants doesn’t hesitate a bit. Wait, he’s not going to put it in, is he? 

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Halloween. It might be a special day for some, but at the same time, it might be a meaningless day for others. Jin-Yeong, who lost his boyfriend, Eun-Chan, 3 years ago, spends his Halloween in the least special way possible. No wait, he was trying to spend it that way. So why did the dead Eun-Chan suddenly appear next to him after all this time? 

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

*“It would have been better to just forget about it.”*

Despite his best efforts, Hyun-Goo is transferred to a local area and returns home. He runs into his high school classmate Moon Sang, who runs the bookstore Jeong-Mun Bookstore, which he used as his hideout, after 10 years, and his heart starts pounding again as memories of their first kiss that he tried hard to bury...

(Source: Peanutoon)

Hyeongwon, a member of the Viper Gang, decides to leave the gang and flee the country. He still has a long way to go, but in a weak moment, he ends up having a one-night stand with  Seongjin... But who is really Seongjin?

display_title: The Baby Concubine Wants to Live Quietly
description:
I possessed a supporting character in a reverse harem novel. 

As a young concubine who gained the interest of the empress. The concubines and male lords, eventually killed her for treason. 

Fortunately, I possessed her just as she was entering the Imperial Palace. Everyone in the Imperial Palace was wary of me, but didn't hate me yet. I don't need, nor do I want to be loved by the empress. 

*"Come to my room tonight. I'll read you a fairy tale!"
'Woo, don't cry. I'll give you this."* 

But why is everyone so kind to me? I couldn't understand. 

(Source: Kakao, translated)

*Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.*

Si-Yun, 33 years old, has never dated anyone. He was never interested in anybody, except that one time when he was in love with his college senior.

On one strange afternoon while on his way home, his eyes caught Hyeon-U, a young man who looked strikingly similar to his old unrequited love. On impulse, he grabs Hyeon-U’s shirt, and shamelessly asks his number and the man… actually gave it. Like a reckless teenager, he dives into this chance at romance with Hyeon-U. But, unlike ordinary relationships, he’ll find that beneath this sweet encounter, lies something deeply twisted.

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

A devil appeared in front of me, who was suffering because of my appearance, and made an attractive offer! I can make the look I want with just one click? CUTE! SEXY! PURE! LUXURY! Raise stats to create the look you want?! But you know... I thought I would be happy if I became prettier... but that doesn't seem to be the case?

The perfect influencer life. Having a date with the girl you like. Only confession remains, but I got caught up in an absurd terrorist incident?! 

*"It's not an obsession, we really...! If we break up, we die!!"* 

(Source: Naver, translated)

*Note:
\- Includes five extra chapters.
\- Part of YLAB's Red String Universe.*

As life gets harder, Ian endures by turning off his emotions.His father's violence and debt-ridden family... Misfortune continued and his body became increasingly numb. Ian, who has become numb to pain, accidentally passes an illegal fighting scene and receives an offer. "If you join the game, I'll give you all the money on this floor." His survival period of surviving in the illegal fighting arena begins! 

(Source: Naver, translated)

On a snowy day, a beautiful transfer student named Anna, joined the boarding school. With Anna's captivating beauty, she became the object of everyone's envy. While Colette, who was the opposite of Anna in every way, builds a delicate love-hate relationship with her. All of a sudden, Anna leaves the school. A long time passes before Colette reunites with Anna, at the place where she starts working as a tutor for a noble family...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Su and Jin-O, who were forced to eat yellow mites by bullies at school, undergo mysterious changes to their bodies and gain the powers of a blob monster.

(Source: Kakao Webtoons, translated) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

A world where "magic" exists. This is a story about a young shaman and his companions saving the world from "curses."

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Seon-U’s mother forces him to go on blind dates. But what happens when a handsome and outgoing man shows up instead? Seon-U, who is tired of going on dates, politely rejects Hyeon, the man who is interested in him. However, when his ex-boyfriend’s wedding invitation arrives, Hyeon absurdly tells Seon-U that he’ll help him seek revenge…He’s going to help? How??

“Well, I’m more handsome, cooler, and younger than him. We can just show him how much better off you are with me, right? We can show him that the perfect man is standing right next to you."

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

*"Hey, Jeong-Il... Do as you wish."*

I got entangled with several women as soon as I entered college. Starting from the boarding house's Ajumma to my friend's girlfriend... Is it really fine to enjoy such a happy campus life?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Yun Si-U is a master of the fighting game "Bloodfist”. Even in real life, he can see a system that usually appears while playing games. Feeling bored with the game, Si-U turns towards actual combat, and tries to use his abilities to conquer his school, but is defeated by the snow leopard Hong Min-Jae. In order to compete with him again, Si-U joins the martial arts club "Lalapalooza"…

(Source: Naver, translated)

A millennium ago, the Blue Moon Kingdom was engulfed in an endless war due to internal conflicts. On the verge of total destruction, the Kingdom was saved by the hands of a masked hero called the 'Red Man'. The survivors exiled the militants who started the rebellion and established the "Blue Moon City", a magnificent civilized paradise led by a large corporation.
Unfortunately, for an elementary school teacher, Mr Kim, being the descendant of the infamous tyrants meant living in the impoverished slums. Although he had nothing to his name, he held his students very close to his heart. But his life took a turn for the worst when his beloved students got kidnapped. As he took his last breath after getting shot by a gunman for attempting to save the kids, the principal of his school handed him a mask which gave him special powers. Kim, resurrected as the incarnation of insatiable, anger sets out to take revenge on the people who ruined his happy life. "I will bring my students back." Criminals beware. A teacher is coming after you to teach you regret and pain.

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)

My freaky imagination about a man turns into his dream?! So, now... should I begin playing with lots of men? 

*"Be careful. You'll be dreaming of me tonight."*

Kang Yeon-U, a physical education student with a strong physique has a secret and that is, he likes pretty and cute things. His hobby is decorating diaries! 

Famous as "Strawberry Fairy" on SNS, he goes to the stationery festival himself after hearing that his favorite artist's new sticker will be released. But due to a turn of events, Kang Yeon-woo's identity as Strawberry Fairy is revealed! 

How will his favorite artist react now that she knows the face behind the famous cute user Strawberry Fairy? 

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: My Childhood Friends Are Trying To Kill Me
description: *Note: Promotional one-shot for the novel of the same name.*

display_title: [High-level BL Short Story Collection] When you close your eyes, your heart races
description:
Seong-Won, a new employee and a gold digger, falls in love with team leader Yang Haru as soon as he joins the company. Seong-Won, who wants to hear the team leader's voice even if it's just an auditory hallucination because he's in love with her, ends up hearing the team leader's voice as an auditory hallucination! But is it really just an auditory hallucination? Or??

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

 *Note: Part of Peanutoon's Gosuwi BL Danpyeonseon (고수위 BL 단편선) Collection.*

Due to a misunderstanding caught on camera in a live program, rumors spread about a fight between two of the members of the girl group DOT. To cover up the scandal, the company launches a master plan... Those involved will have to pretend to be in a relationship!

*Note: Chapter count includes 2 extra chapters*

Jun-Ho Kim loved pro-wrestling more than anyone but he couldn’t escape the racial standards. After his meaningless retirement, while working as a construction worker, he got caught up in an unexpected accident… and when he opened his eyes, he returned to the day before his WWF entrance exam! 

“This time, I won’t end as the villain ‘king-fury’ with a 0.7% success rate!” 

He returned to his 20s body with all the knowledge he’s worked so hard for and information about the future. He will not repeat his history of being ‘jobber’, the expert at losing. He will rewrite the history of pro wrestling together with the wrestler that will take over the future, to ultimately become the god of pro wrestling, an ‘icon’ of the era!

Hana can see different future outcomes based on the choices that people make. But when she enters college and meets someone whose future she can't see, her life takes an unexpected turn. In order to avoid the worst possible future, will she be forced to make the worst choice?

Childhood friends Yeon-Woo and Ji-Soo love each other, but their inability to express their feelings verbally leads to misunderstandings and clashes. They attended kindergarten and college together, yet never find the time to confess their feelings. As time passes, the distance that hinders them only grows wider. Yeon-Woo's confession, Ji-Soo's confession—more than once, with repeated failures—they seem to be growing increasingly distant...

When will they finally be able to finally convey their feelings?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

O Jin-Deok, a public service agent who was ignored by Park A-Yeong, a sexy but bad-natured woman, accidentally finds out about the corruption of Park A-Yeong and makes a secret deal with her… 

*“Se… Sex is only once a month!”*

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

I lived to the age of 19, only to be constantly taken advantage of by fake family members. With the vow to seek revenge still fresh in my mind, I made the choice to live my life again. Yet why have I returned to the night I was kidnapped from a burning castle? 

"Hwelp me! Hwelp me! The willian ish twaking Maedie!" 

My savior ended up being the enemy's son?! For days and nights I followed him to the enemy's castle, but upon arrival, a warm welcome... 

"Ack! Father! Second Brother's picked up another living thing!" 

...wasn't what awaited me. 

(Source: Kakao, translated) 

*Note: Webcomic prologue of the homonym web novel.*

No more unrequited love! The hottest rumor in Going High School is that if you put money in the old clothes collection bin and shout out your favorite person's name, it will tell you how the other person feels...!

Song A-Ram, who is only interested in grades and money instead of dating, is not swayed by such rumors. Then Jeong Jin-U, a popular guy at school, suddenly enters A-Ram's daily life. Now what is she supposed to do with a guy who doesn't know where he's going?

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: A Master of the Fall of Blossoms
description:
Kim Sojin lived an intense everyday life as an oriental doctor. However, after losing her life in a fire accident, she woke up again in the Goguryeo period as the daughter of the Jeolnobu Yeon Clan 'Yeon Woohee.' 

Although she was born into a noble family, war breaks out every day in this era! And now that she's twelve, she's going through a political marriage?!

Baek Dong-hee, a high school student who once pursued his dream of being the best b-boy in the world, but lost his dreams and hopes due to an accident. One day, he meets Kwon Jin-i, a girl who works out with a bare body, and his life, which had stopped, begins to move again.

*Promotional Manhwa for the webnovel.* 

I came into the world of a novel I was reading, and became an unknown extra destined for a miserable life. Teaching manners to a crazy bastard who turns into a tyrant? 

Manners, my ass! 

Quick thinking was my only means of survival. I tried everything to prevent such a tragic relationship with the tyrant from happening. I kicked, punched and screamed his head off, but I was still beaten in the end. Actually, he’s unexpectedly docile at times and even told me, 

“You’re the first person who understands me.” 

The male lead’s personality is strange.
The Murim Warring States period is where only the strong survives. This is the war slave Cheong Gwang and Myeong-Wol’s Murim Survival Story.

Do-hee hates people's inconsiderate stares.
She even cut her hair because she hated it, but the attention never ceases.
One day, a fatigued and frustrated Do-hee received a link.
A familiar room, similar body type, and a red mole above her belly button
What catches the eye more than the naked body in the video.
What is this... Roommate... Cha Bo-bin!?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/red_dot/?p_id=tw1517), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/red_dot)

"Just why do I have to possess someone who’s already possessed...?!"

I became the female lead in the novel "I Possessed the Villain’s Granddaughter", who is already possessed. But the truth is, she’s actually the villainess who will torment the real heroine. What do you mean I’ve become the villainess who will suffer terribly for harassing the heroine? I can’t believe it! My fate was sealed to become trash before I knew it! I can’t live like this!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the web novel of the same name.*

I found someone who looks exactly like me on SNS! He seems to have everything unlike me who grew up in an orphanage. Maybe he could be my twin?! When I was about to find him and solve my life problems, I got into huge trouble!! 

(Source: YLAB) 

*Note: Belongs to Blue String universe.*

Hae-Jin's team is always at the bottom of the leaderboard. Mi-Ho, the new ace salesperson on Hae-Jin's team, is at odds with the inflexible Hae-Jin. "Team leader, you're too rigid". An ace saleswoman who sells every policy and a rigid team leader.

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

*"I'm different from that person, too different!"* 

Cheong-Uk and Un-Ho have been living together for three months due to unavoidable circumstances. The two people who don't match at all end up clashing and fighting over trivial things. Their anger towards each other builds up and before they know it, they're on the verge of exploding, but Un-Ho ends up revealing his secret to Cheong-Uk...! 

Will Cheong-Uk and Un-Ho be able to get along without any problems in the future?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Ha-Buk Paeng Family’s best strength, Ji-Hyuk Paeng heads to the Nakho Region to save his family that fell into destruction due to the attack of the Demon Sect, but everything was a trap. At the moment of death, he felt the wrath of being the only one left from his beloved family.

*"Again…if you give me a chance…!”* 

Paeng Ji-Hyuk, who thought he was dead, woke up in the body of Young Master Sa, of the Paeng Family.

When will the celebrity career of two-faced actress Min Seo-Hui end?

The popular movie actress Min Seo-Hui's pretty face and excellent acting skills are enough to win the public’s love.

Her shocking secret is that she is a lesbian who has numerous love affairs with fellow entertainers to staff members and even managers! Her agency, unable to tolerate Seo-Hui's numerous relationships, assigns Mi-So, the embodiment of normalcy, as her manager.

There is only one person who failed to succumb to Seo-Hui's advances - Dong-Gyeong, a junior from the theater club she attended during her pre-debut days, who now works as a film director. Reunited at a high school classmate’s funeral, Dong-Gyeong is still aloof. Seo-Hui, whose ego is hurt, takes the lead role in the film director’s independent film in order to seduce the woman she couldn't have… 

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

display_title: Becoming the Only Memory of the Male Lead
description:
The body was possessed before the start of the novel.
Also, she, the daughter of a Count, is an extra who is bound to be murdered.

She didn't want to die like this, so she went in search of the male lead who's filled with the energy of life. The problem is that, due to his curse, he can't remember others.
As the next best solution, she even tried to target his subordinates.

*"It's been long, Loreina."*
What? Why does this person remember me?
It was unexpectedly due to an exception of the curse. Um. Well, I'll help you until the female lead appears. The only one who can break the curse is the female lead, so that it doesn't deviate from the original story. 

...Yeah, that's exactly what she thought.

(Source: Kakao, translated)

*Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.*

While watching the famous Serengeti “Three Colors” sunset at a bar, Ian, a former military soldier, met Lucy, a man who looked somewhat familiar. Ian was swept away by his charm, and invited Lucy to his room.

I feel comfortable with Lucy’s beautiful smile and gentle touch, but can I do it with a man that I just met three hours ago? Maybe... 

*“Are you going to put it in me?”*

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

'Cherry' is forced to go on a trip to Paris following a travel app due to her sister's threats. In a completely new place, he encounters his very familiar rival, 'Lemon'. 

'Cherry' tries to ignore 'Lemon', which makes him angry, and accidentally meets his partner 'Peach', and is drawn to 'Peach' who perfectly matches her ideal type... 

The three become partners at the same time due to an error in the travel app of 'Lemon', 'Cherry', and 'Peach' as ​​if they interfered with the love of 'Cherry'! 

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

The painter Joseph, who has excellent modeling skills but is not recognized for his lack of creative talent, tries to make an extreme choice, unable to overcome his sense of shame.

The secret woman who stopped him, Renee. Joseph's heart flutters when she asks him to draw a picture for her and he follows her to the painter's city, Delmo, to seize the last chance.

However, after arriving at 'Delmo', he receives a completely different quest from his expectations...

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/Davidmourn), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/portrait_of_david), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000054626), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9029169), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1434014565), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/62140143)

**Official Translations:**  
[French](https://www.lezhinfr.com/detail/daf_1000600), [T.Chinese](https://www.bomtoon.tw/detail/Davidmourn)

Lee Seonho, who took care of his parent's store while they were on a trip, meets Yoohwa, a customer that visits one day.

After their first meeting, he discovered that he had a gentle personality and his job was growing flowers. But one day, he discovers that his boyfriend needs to eat people to live? What kind of crazy...?!

In the early Joseon Dynasty, Hong Chunki, a worker at the Baekyu Flower Group, catches a man who has fallen from the sky on the night of the winter solstice. Looking at the handsome looking man as if he were not of this world, Hong Chunki remembers the words of his mother who prayed for her single daughter to have a good marriage and believes he is her heaven given man.

Haram, a man who was blinded after being involved in an unknown accident while attending a festival as a child. After meeting Hong Chunki, he discovers the secret around her eyes.

[Original Web Novel](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=6314473)

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=778748), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6489933)

**Official Translations:**  
[Indonesian](https://www.webtoons.com/id/romance/lovers-of-the-red-sky/list?title_no=3492), [S.Chinese](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/episodeList?titleNo=1795), [T.Chinese](https://www.webtoons.com/zh-hant/adaptation/redsky/list?title_no=3277), [Japanese](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0003546) 

***Note:** This is the webtoon version of the **K-Drama** with the same title which aired on Aug 30, 2021.*

In a village deep in the mountains, Jeong-soon is one of the few girls in the village. Geum-hwa, Jeong-soon's only friend, leaves for Gyeongseong with the help of the villagers. Jeong-soon, who is heartbroken by Geum-hwa, shoots in the forest and sees a nine-tailed fox eating some humans.. 

(source: Bomtoon, translated)

display_title: The Witch's Judgement of Becoming a Flower
description:
Seon-Hwa, who senses the stench of evildoers, meets Jeong-Hyang, who has a scent for the first time in her life. However, Jeong-Hyang, who she thought was only good, is actually a witch who turns evildoers into flowers...

 *'Is there anyone you want to kill?'* 

(Source: Naver, translated)

*Note: Part of YLAB's Red String Universe.*

Flora was born to become the main character, and 'I' will always stand behind her. Being sacrificed or beaten with wretched words didn’t matter if it made Flora shine every time. Because I thought that a role was just a role.

But Flora, I have to kill you and end this play now.

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

display_title: I Want to Die in Peace!
description:
*Promotional Manhwa for the novel.* 

I now possess the body of Ophelia, the villainess in the story 'The Crown Prince Returns'. And just like the protagonists in the other reincarnated novels, I thought I would fare well. I died by getting guillotined the first time, the second time was getting my limbs torn apart, third was suicide by poison, and by the fourth time, I was struck with arrows atop the throne. And by the fifth restart, even if I tried to stray from the original storyline, I would still be doomed to die. "Concoct a poison for me. Not one that’s painful, but one that’ll kill me slowly." Therefore, this time, with all my heart and soul, I wished to die properly for once. "After I ascend the throne, are you leaving me behind?" "I sincerely hope that her highness survives, no matter what." "Your Highness, I wish to get to know you better." All these people surrounding aren't letting me die off easily!

University student Han San notices Ji Eun-Seong, who is working on a group assignment, and remembers seeing him having sex with a man in a bar bathroom the other day. San approaches Eun-Seong, who looks innocent, with a light heart... 

Why does it seem like he's just being swung around? It's all because it's his first time with someone older!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Ban Su-Ho, a guard who died after failing to protect the Princess from the assassins! Back in time two years through an unknown force! *“This time, I must…”* Determined to protect the Princess he sets out in search of the sealed power to become stronger. Will he be able to protect the Princess?

(Source: Kakao, translated)

display_title: The Rules of a Contractual Relationship
description:
Mu Jungwoo is a fine arts student who is now taking a nude croquis class. One day, a guy called Jaehoon appears as the new nude model, and Jung-woo gets really fixated on him due to Jaehoon’s very attractive features. 

Everyone is curious about Jaehoon’s hidden identity. Jungwoo then starts following Jaehoon, requesting him to model for him personally. While following him around, Jungwoo unexpectedly sees Jaehoon's true form. 

Jungwoo finally gives up as Jaehoon keeps coldly rejecting his request. But suddenly, a few days later, Jaehoon appears and gives Jungwoo a contract, saying that he'll be his model!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list.nhn?titleId=765471), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=5950557)

The monsters take everything away from a boy and keep him captive as their food. He grits his teeth and seeks revenge, but human strength isn’t enough to beat the monsters. At that moment, a monster hunter appears…

Han Si-Woo lost one leg when he was young. He was bullied in school and stigmatized by people who met him. Using a “smart leg”, he started skateboarding and after displaying excellent balance and skills he managed to join the “extreme crew”. He has to overcome his rivals and obstacles in his way. Will Han Si-Woo be able to overcome all these things and prove that he is capable to participate in the national team selection?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Han Kang, who has just been discharged from the military, meets a naked stranger, Kang Rae-In, at his older sister's house that he visited after a long time. Han Kang, who mistakes the adult Kang Rae-In for a high school student with nowhere to go, takes pity on him and invites him into his room, and the two suddenly start living together...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

1. Migaebaryeongyeok (미개발영역) \[Nire\]
2. Hwanbureun An Dwaeyo! (환불은 안 돼요!) \[Da-Sik\]
3. Peach, Pitchi Tail (피치, 핏치 테일) \[Yu-Je\]
4. Magical ☆ Useless Gift (매지컬☆유즈리스 기프트) \[Chaegu\]
5. My Little Rabbit (마이 리틀 래빗) \[Komello\]

Since childhood, Hasu has had a long-standing crush on her close friend Saetbyeol. Even though it’s gone on for a long time, Hasu is content—just like always—to stay in her place as Saetbyeol’s best friend. Believing she knows everything about Saetbyeol, Hasu also knows that whenever Saetbyeol gets confessed to, she always turns them down by saying she already likes someone—and Hasu has never thought much of it. But one afternoon after school, Hasu sees Saetbyeol face-to-face with a boy from their class, and Hasu’s heart fills with endless anxiety.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/hugstar/), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/hug_star)

display_title: I Want to XX With You!
description:
San-Ho, who can't have a relationship with a real human even if he died, falls in love with a game called \[Dragon God\], recommended by his cousin Jeong-Ho 

Then, one day, a mysterious message popped up on screen, and a master poet appeared before me! 

(Source: Naver, Translated)

Even though Ji Jiri is the most powerful person in the world, he lives as if he's the weakest.

Jiri is born to a mother who bears immense power and a father from a gangster family. Ever since he was a newborn, he has shown his Herculean strength by demolishing his own house, furniture, and even his dad(?). 

In order to let him live a normal life, his parents brainwashed him.

“You are the worst to ever walk on earth.”
“Never get close to anyone.”

This is the story of Ji Jiri’s personal growth and overcoming traumas to become the strongest man on earth.
